items.title: 美傳奇投資人Baron：SpaceX市值十年後可能達到20兆至50兆美元
items.title_en: Legendary Investor Baron Says SpaceX Could Be Worth $20‑$50 Trillion in Ten Years
paras: 矽谷知名投資人、巴倫資本創辦人Ron Baron近日在哥倫比亞商學院活動中表示，SpaceX十年後市值可能達20兆至50兆美元，股價可望「每股數千美元」，並稱馬斯克覺得這個估計「仍太低」。
這位億萬富翁投資人建議友人持續按月買進SpaceX，若因帳面虧損焦慮，「就找券商再買一些」。Baron還說，SpaceX現階段市值約2.1兆美元，近期股價約156.54美元。
SpaceX成長核心首先看星鏈。Baron估計，星鏈十年後估值約14兆至15兆美元，目前仍處早期，其假設用戶由約1500萬增至3億，年營收由現約150億至170億美元升至1兆美元，EBITDA達7000億至8000億美元。
他並指出，政府、企業與AI代理需求，以及全球偏遠地區連網，是主要放大因子。
另一動能是太空資料中心。Baron稱其規模「可能是未來星鏈的數倍」，理由是地面機房受電力、散熱、用地與民眾抗爭阻礙限制，「地球上已難再大舉興建」；結合星艦低軌發射、星鏈回傳與軌道運算，可繞開部分地面瓶頸。
Baron對投資人喊出「至少20到30倍」回報，但相關預測屬長期假設，仍取決於放量、獲利與監管進度。
paras_en: Silicon Valley investor and founder of Baren Capital Ron Baron told a Columbia Business School event that SpaceX’s market value could reach $20‑$50 trillion in ten years, with a share price potentially “in the thousands of dollars,” and said Elon Musk thinks this estimate is still too low.

The billionaire investor advised friends to keep buying SpaceX shares monthly, and if they feel anxious about paper losses, “just go to a broker and buy more.” Baron also noted that SpaceX’s current market cap is about $2.1 trillion, with a recent share price around $156.54.

Baron said SpaceX’s growth hinges on Starlink. He estimates Starlink could be valued at $14‑$15 trillion in ten years; it is still early, with users projected to rise from about 15 million to 300 million and annual revenue climbing from roughly $15 billion‑$17 billion today to $1 trillion, yielding EBITDA of $700‑$800 billion.
He added that demand from governments, enterprises and AI agents, as well as connectivity for remote areas worldwide, are the main amplification factors.

Another driver is space data centers. Baron claimed their scale “could be several times that of future Starlink,” arguing that terrestrial data centers are limited by power, cooling, land and public opposition, making large new builds on Earth difficult; combining Starship low‑orbit launches, Starlink downlink and orbital computing could bypass some ground bottlenecks.
Baron told investors to expect “at least 20‑30 times” returns, but cautioned that these long‑term forecasts depend on volume growth, profitability and regulatory progress.

items.title: 新加坡Q3經濟成長5.4%超預期 全年展望維持4.5%至5.5%
items.title_en: Singapore Q3 Economic Growth 5.4% Beats Expectations, Full-Year Outlook Remains 4.5% to 5.5%
paras: 新加坡能源、貿易暨工業部(METI)周三(14日)發布最新預估數據顯示，新加坡2026年第三季GDP年增5.4%，優於預期的5.0%。經季節調整後，第三季GDP季增1.1%，稍微低於市場預期的1.2%與上一季的1.5%。
在各產業表現方面，第三季製造業年增7.5%，主要由電子、精密工程、運輸工程與一般製造業群聚支撐，抵銷了化學與生物醫學製造業的衰退，但經季調後製造業季減0.9%。
整體經濟成長延續上半年的強勁趨勢，主要受惠於人工智慧(AI)相關產業與出口表現拉動。政府維持2026全年GDP成長預測於4.5%至5.5%。
此外，新加坡金融管理局(MAS)宣布維持貨幣政策不變，暫停先前因能源價格上漲所採取的緊縮政策。對此，星展銀行(DBS)分析師指出，央行暫緩緊縮主要反映通膨展望較先前預期放緩。
星展銀行分析師預估，新加坡2026年整體CPI平均年增率為2%，核心通膨率放緩至1.5%至2.0%。然而，分析師也提醒，短期內能源價格回升可能帶來通膨壓力，且全球利率若高於預期以及AI投資出現較大幅度拉回，仍是全球與新加坡經濟面臨的主要風險。
金融市場方面，新加坡元兌美元匯率維持在1.26至1.30狹幅震盪，新加坡海峽時報指數上揚0.3%。
paras_en: Singapore's Ministry of Trade and Industry (METI) released its latest estimates on Wednesday (the 14th), showing that Singapore's GDP grew 5.4% year‑on‑year in the third quarter of 2026, ahead of the 5.0% forecast. Seasonally adjusted, the quarter‑on‑quarter GDP increase was 1.1%, slightly below the market expectation of 1.2% and down from 1.5% in the previous quarter.

In terms of sector performance, manufacturing expanded 7.5% year‑on‑year in the third quarter, driven mainly by clusters in electronics, precision engineering, transport engineering and general manufacturing, which offset declines in chemicals and biomedical manufacturing. After seasonal adjustment, manufacturing fell 0.9% quarter‑on‑quarter.

Overall economic growth continued the strong momentum seen in the first half of the year, largely supported by AI‑related industries and export performance. The government kept its full‑year 2026 GDP growth forecast at 4.5%‑5.5%.

In addition, the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) announced that monetary policy would remain unchanged, pausing the tightening measures previously introduced in response to rising energy prices. DBS analysts noted that the central bank’s pause mainly reflects a slower‑than‑expected inflation outlook.

DBS analysts project Singapore's overall CPI to average a 2% year‑on‑year increase in 2026, with core inflation easing to between 1.5% and 2.0%. However, they caution that a short‑term rebound in energy prices could revive inflationary pressure, and that higher‑than‑expected global interest rates and a sharp pull‑back in AI investment remain key risks for both the global and Singapore economies.
In the financial markets, the Singapore dollar held steady against the US dollar in a narrow range of 1.26‑1.30, while the Straits Times Index rose 0.3%.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉台塑四寶、被動元件撐盤 尾盤摜壓漲點收斂至284點
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Post‑Market: Formosa Plastics’ Four Treasures and Passive Components Support the Market; Late‑Session Selling Compresses Gains to 284 Points
paras: 台股今 (14) 日反彈，台積電早盤站回2500元，電子權值股台達電、鴻海同步走揚，及台塑四寶等塑化股也有買盤進駐，大盤盤中一度上漲逾700點、重返49000點大關，盤中漲幅收斂。而在最後一盤賣壓下摜156.78點，終場收48625.83點，上漲284.52點，成交量9286.24億元。
電子權值股漲跌互現，台積電 (2330-TW) 持平，收2490元；聯發科 (2454-TW)下跌50元，跌約1%；鴻海 (2317-TW) 漲1%，日月光投控 (3711-TW)漲近1%，台達電 (2308-TW) 漲0.5%，廣達 (2382-TW) 持平。
台塑四寶第三季自結財報公布後，塑化股續受關注，台塑 (1301-TW)、台化 (1326-TW) 漲停，南亞 (1303-TW) 漲約9%；台塑化 (6505-TW) 收紅。
被動元件股同步反彈，華新科 (2492-TW) 漲逾8%，國巨 (2327-TW) 盤中最高635元，終場收4%；禾伸堂 (3026-TW) 盤中最高880元，漲場漲近6%。
銅箔基板 (CCL) 族群也有買盤回流，聯茂 (6213-TW) 漲約7%，台燿 (6274-TW) 漲約4%；台光電 (2383-TW) 收黑。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks rebounded today (the 14th), with TSMC regaining the NT$2,500 level in the early session. Electronics heavyweight stocks Delta Electronics and Foxconn rose together, and the Formosa Plastics “four treasures” plus other petrochemical stocks attracted buying. The index surged more than 700 points mid‑session, briefly retaking the 49,000‑point threshold, before the rally narrowed. In the final session, selling pressure knocked back 156.78 points, closing at 48,625.83, up 284.52 points, with a turnover of NT$928.624 billion.

Electronics heavyweight stocks showed mixed moves: TSMC (2330‑TW) was flat at NT$2,490; MediaTek (2454‑TW) fell NT$50, about 1%; Foxconn (2317‑TW) rose 1%; ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW) gained nearly 1%; Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) rose 0.5%; Quanta Computer (2382‑TW) was unchanged.

After the release of its third‑quarter self‑reported earnings, the petrochemical sector remained in focus. Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) and Formosa Chemical (1326‑TW) hit their daily limits up, Nan Ya (1303‑TW) rose about 9%, and Formosa Chemicals & Fibre (6505‑TW) closed in the green.

Passive component stocks also rebounded: Huaxin Technology (2492‑TW) jumped over 8%; Yageo (2327‑TW) peaked at NT$635 intraday and closed at NT$4; Hoshin (3026‑TW) reached a high of NT$880 intraday, gaining nearly 6% during the session.
Copper‑clad laminate (CCL) stocks saw buying return: Lianmao (6213‑TW) rose about 7%, Tai Yao (6274‑TW) climbed roughly 4%, while Tai Optical (2383‑TW) closed lower.

items.title: 艾司摩爾AI需求旺到2030年！第三季獲利超預期、EUV設備產能吃緊
items.title_en: ASML AI Demand Strong Through 2030! Q3 Profit Beats Expectations, EUV Equipment Capacity Tight
paras: 全球半導體設備龍頭艾司摩爾(ASML-US) 指出，部分客戶已開始表達對2029年、甚至2030年下單採購關鍵半導體設備的興趣，顯示人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮帶動的晶片需求，正進一步延伸至未來數年。艾司摩爾第三季獲利優於市場預期，也為關注其長期成長動能的投資人帶來支撐。
根據《CNBC》報導，艾司摩爾執行長Christophe Fouquet在聲明中表示，客戶持續上修短期與中期設備需求預測，主要受到AI相關投資規模及持續時間預期的影響。
他進一步指出：「考慮到客戶對需求的掌握程度，部分客戶已表達有意向我們下訂2029年、甚至2030年的設備。」
艾司摩爾是全球唯一能生產極紫外光（EUV）微影設備的公司。這類設備是製造最先進半導體的關鍵工具，台積電(2330-TW) 等晶片製造商仰賴相關技術推進先進製程，因此艾司摩爾的財報與訂單展望，一直是投資人觀察AI晶片需求的重要指標。
Fouquet也指出，艾司摩爾目前規劃在2027年與2028年提供的設備產能，仍不足以完全滿足客戶需求。公司正研究擴產方式，希望讓2028年的產能增幅超越先前預估的30%。
本季期間，全球兩大晶片製造商三星電子(005930KS) 與台積電均承諾採用艾司摩爾的高數值孔徑（High NA）極紫外光（EUV）微影設備。
High NA EUV是艾司摩爾的新一代設備，分析師認為，這項技術將是推動該公司未來成長的關鍵。
今年7月，由於設備需求持續強勁，艾司摩爾上修全年銷售額及毛利率預測。該公司股價今年以來已上漲56%。
艾司摩爾週三（14日）縮小全年營收預測區間，並表示目前預估全年淨銷售額將介於440億至450億歐元（493億至504億美元）之間。先前預測區間的下限為430億歐元。
艾司摩爾也預估，第四季淨銷售額將介於142億至152億歐元之間，預測區間上限高於倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）分析師142億歐元的共識預估。
艾司摩爾第三季淨利達49.6億歐元，明顯高於LSEG預期的41億歐元；不過，單季淨銷售額為116.6億歐元，略低於LSEG預估的117.2億歐元。
paras_en: Global semiconductor equipment leader ASML (ASML-US) said that some customers have already begun expressing interest in placing orders for key semiconductor equipment for 2029 and even 2030, indicating that the chip demand driven by the AI investment boom is extending further into the coming years. ASML's third‑quarter profit exceeded market expectations, providing support for investors focused on its long‑term growth momentum.

According to a CNBC report, ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet said in a statement that customers are continuously revising up their short‑ and medium‑term equipment demand forecasts, mainly due to expectations about the scale and duration of AI‑related investments.
He added, "Given the level of insight customers have into demand, some have indicated an intention to place orders with us for equipment in 2029 and even 2030."

ASML is the only company in the world that can produce extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography machines. These tools are critical for manufacturing the most advanced semiconductors, and chipmakers such as TSMC (2330‑TW) rely on the technology to advance their leading‑edge processes, making ASML's earnings and order outlook a key gauge of AI chip demand for investors.

Fouquet also noted that the equipment capacity ASML plans to provide in 2027 and 2028 is still insufficient to fully meet customer demand. The company is studying ways to expand production, aiming for a capacity increase in 2028 that exceeds the previously forecasted 30% growth.
During the quarter, the world’s two largest chip manufacturers, Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and TSMC, both pledged to adopt ASML’s High‑NA (high numerical aperture) EUV lithography equipment.
High‑NA EUV is ASML’s next‑generation system, and analysts believe this technology will be a key driver of the company’s future growth.
In July, due to continued strong equipment demand, ASML raised its full‑year sales and gross‑margin forecasts. The company’s share price has risen 56% so far this year.

On Wednesday (the 14th), ASML narrowed its full‑year revenue guidance, stating that it now expects net sales for the year to be between €44 billion and €45 billion (US$49.3 billion to US$50.4 billion). The lower bound of the previous range was €43 billion.

ASML also projected fourth‑quarter net sales to be between €14.2 billion and €15.2 billion, with the upper end of the range above the consensus estimate of €14.2 billion from London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) analysts.
ASML’s third‑quarter net profit reached €4.96 billion, well above LSEG’s forecast of €4.1 billion; however, quarterly net sales were €11.66 billion, slightly below LSEG’s estimate of €11.72 billion.

items.title: 中美AI算力應用大不同：中國聚焦短劇、影音 美國深耕程式碼開發
items.title_en: China and US AI Compute Applications Differ Greatly: China Focuses on Short Drama and Video, US Deepens Code Development
paras: 根據多家全球與中國產業監測機構最新數據顯示，中美兩國在大語言模型與算力 Token 的消耗方向上呈現顯著差異。中國的 AI 算力主要集中於微短劇生成與行銷視覺內容，而美國則高度聚焦於程式碼生成與企業流程自動化。這項對比引發了市場對於兩國 AI 發展路徑與商業化落地效率的廣泛討論。

數據揭示兩地應用場景分流

據中文線上與第三方監測機構報告，美國約 58% 的 Token 算力運用於程式碼生成和企業自動化流程，而中國投向軟體開發的算力僅占 15%。
相反地，中國有高達 55% 的算力用於 AI 微短劇與短影音生成，24% 投入電商帶貨與行銷圖文製作。
此外，中國信息通信研究院的 2026 年第三季監測指出，中國國內微短劇相關內容生成的 Token 消耗占比達 32.7%，居所有應用場景首位；而 Gartner 的全球監測數據顯示，美國程式開發場景則以 38.2% 的占比長期穩居第一。

市場付費結構決定算力流向

針對兩國應用的顯著分野，業內分析指出，這反映了兩地市場不同的付費結構與商業轉化模式。
在中國市場，2026 年前八個月全國上線微短劇達 43 萬部，其中超過九成有 AI 深度參與劇本、分鏡與數位人合成。AI 將傳統微短劇的製作週期從數週縮短至數天，總成本自數十萬人民幣降至數千元甚至更低。龐大的影音用戶基數與成熟的付費解鎖機制，使內容生成具備快速的投資報酬率(ROI)，進而拉動算力需求。
反觀美國，北美資深軟體工程師年薪高達 30 萬至 50 萬美元，企業 IT 預算中軟體與雲端服務占比達六至七成。使用 AI 輔助寫程式能使研發效率提升 30% 以上，為企業節減巨額人力開支。相比之下，中國企業 IT 支出中軟體服務僅占約 18%，導致程式開發類 AI 工具的收費門檻相對較高。

算力底座與發展瓶頸的考驗

除了應用層面，兩國在算力基礎設施上也面臨不同的外部制約。
美國資本大量湧入資料中心建設，黑石集團(Blackstone)總裁透露，旗下企業對大語言模型的需求在半年內成長了七倍；貝萊德(BlackRock)執行長芬克(Larry Fink)亦將資料中心融資視為金融工程的新前沿。
然而，美電網負載過載與電費上漲引發民眾反對，社區反對建置資料中心的比例自 2025 年的 40% 飆升至 2026 年的 75%，構成實體擴展的硬性邊界。
中國則憑藉整體統籌在能源與基礎建設上具備推進優勢，但《證券時報》的調查指出，部分地方國資項目採取「先建設後找需求」模式，採購中低端晶片與下游實際需求脫節，導致資產閒置與資源錯配。
paras_en: According to the latest data from multiple global and Chinese industry monitoring agencies, China and the United States show a striking difference in how large‑language‑model and compute token consumption is allocated. In China, AI compute is mainly used for generating micro‑short dramas and marketing visual content, while in the United States it is heavily focused on code generation and enterprise process automation. This contrast has sparked broad market discussion about the two countries’ AI development paths and commercialization efficiency.

The data reveal a split in application scenarios between the two regions. Reports from Chinese online and third‑party monitoring agencies show that about 58% of U.S. token compute is used for code generation and corporate automation, whereas only 15% of China’s compute is devoted to software development.
Conversely, up to 55% of China’s compute is employed for AI micro‑short drama and short‑video generation, and 24% is invested in e‑commerce livestreaming and marketing graphic production.

In addition, the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology’s Q3 2026 monitoring indicated that token consumption for domestic micro‑short drama content generation accounts for 32.7% of total use, the highest among all scenarios; Gartner’s global monitoring data shows the U.S. code‑development scenario consistently holds the top share at 38.2%.

The market’s payment structure determines the direction of compute flow. Analysts note that the pronounced divergence in applications reflects differing payment structures and commercial conversion models in the two markets.

In China, 430,000 micro‑short dramas were launched nationwide in the first eight months of 2026, with over 90% involving deep AI participation in scriptwriting, storyboarding and digital‑human synthesis. AI has shortened the traditional production cycle from weeks to days, reducing total costs from hundreds of thousands of yuan to a few thousand yuan or less. The massive video‑user base and mature pay‑to‑unlock mechanisms give content generation a rapid ROI, driving compute demand.

In contrast, senior North American software engineers earn $300,000‑$500,000 annually, and software and cloud services comprise 60‑70% of corporate IT budgets. Using AI to assist coding can boost R&D efficiency by more than 30%, saving companies huge labor costs. By comparison, software services account for only about 18% of Chinese enterprises’ IT spend, making the pricing barrier for code‑development AI tools relatively high.
Beyond the application layer, the two countries also face different external constraints on compute infrastructure.

U.S. capital is pouring into data‑center construction; Blackstone’s president said its portfolio companies’ demand for large‑language models has grown seven‑fold in six months, and BlackRock CEO Larry Fink views data‑center financing as a new frontier of financial engineering.

However, overload on the U.S. power grid and rising electricity costs have sparked public opposition, with community resistance to data‑center builds jumping from 40% in 2025 to 75% in 2026, creating a hard limit on physical expansion.

China leverages overall coordination in energy and infrastructure to push ahead, but a Securities Times investigation found that some local state‑owned projects adopt a “build first, find demand later” approach, purchasing mid‑to‑low‑end chips that are mismatched with downstream needs, leading to idle assets and resource misallocation.

items.title: 痛批蓄意推高油價！川普：胡塞武裝這波行動「非常惡劣」 可能要求土耳其加入打擊
items.title_en: Trump Slams Deliberate Oil‑Price Hike! Calls Houthi Action “Extremely Malicious” and May Ask Turkey to Join the Fight
paras: 美國總統川普周二(13日)表示，可能要求土耳其加入沙烏地阿拉伯對葉門胡塞武裝(又譯青年運動)的打擊行動。「我可能會這麼做，我非常尊重土耳其總統艾爾段，相信他會配合。」此言顯示華府與波斯灣盟友正考慮擴大軍事回應，油價與航空風險隨之升溫。
事件起因是上周六(10日)利雅德哈立德國王國際機場航廈遇襲，沙國稱造成12死309傷，川普當日曾稱正評估美國是否加入沙國打擊胡塞，將盡快決定。
川普周二在Truth Social上痛批胡塞以「非常惡劣」手段攻擊沙國，並疑似刻意在美国期中大選前推高油價。
川普出訪阿拉斯加前證實已跟沙國王儲兼首相穆罕默德通話，但拒透露是否已決定參戰，僅稱將就伊朗問題很快作成決定。
近幾日沙國與胡塞持續互攻，沙國主導多國聯軍周一(12日)稱攔截數枚胡塞彈道飛彈；胡塞則指沙國過去24個小時對葉門多地空襲119次，造成民用設施損毀與平民傷亡，多家航空公司因此暫停飛利雅德。
胡塞控制的馬西拉電視台周二報導指出，薩那葉門石油公司設施遭襲，聯軍稍早聲明將打擊該目標。胡塞警告，若薩那設施受擊，將回擊沙國東部達曼沙烏地阿美石油總部、利雅德機場及沙烏地阿美旗下煉油廠。
今年8月，沙國、土耳其與巴基斯坦簽署《麥加共同防務協議》，明定任一方遭武裝攻擊視同對全體攻擊。分析人士指出，若美國正式邀土國參戰，配合該協議與美方增兵評估，衝突可能由葉門、沙國進一步牽動伊朗代理人網絡，全球能源市場波動恐加劇。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday (the 13th) that he may ask Turkey to join Saudi Arabia’s campaign against Yemen’s Houthi rebels (also known as the Youth Movement). “I might do that, I have great respect for Turkish President Erdogan and I believe he will cooperate,” he said, indicating that Washington and its Gulf allies are considering expanding the military response, which could push oil prices and aviation risks higher.

The incident stems from an attack last Saturday (the 10th) on the terminal of King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, which Saudi officials said caused 12 deaths and 309 injuries. Trump said on that day that the United States was evaluating whether to join Saudi strikes against the Houthis and would decide soon.

On Tuesday, Trump used his Truth Social platform to harshly criticize the Houthis for attacking Saudi Arabia with “extremely malicious” tactics and suggested they were deliberately trying to drive up oil prices ahead of the U.S. mid‑term elections.

Before his trip to Alaska, Trump confirmed he had spoken with Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman but declined to say whether a decision to enter the war had been made, adding only that a decision on Iran would be reached quickly.

In recent days Saudi Arabia and the Houthis have continued to exchange attacks. The Saudi‑led multinational coalition said on Monday (the 12th) it intercepted several Houthi ballistic missiles; the Houthis claimed Saudi airstrikes hit Yemen at 119 locations in the past 24 hours, damaging civilian infrastructure and causing civilian casualties, prompting several airlines to suspend flights to Riyadh.

The Houthi‑controlled Masyra TV reported on Tuesday that facilities of Yemen’s state oil company in Sana’a had been hit, and the coalition earlier announced it would target that site. The Houthis warned that if the Sana’a facilities were struck they would retaliate against Saudi Arabia’s eastern Dammam headquarters of Saudi Aramco, Riyadh airport and Aramco‑owned refineries.

In August this year, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan signed the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement, which treats an armed attack on any signatory as an attack on all. Analysts note that if the United States formally invites Turkey to join the fight, aligning with that pact and U.S. force‑building assessments could expand the conflict from Yemen and Saudi Arabia to Iran’s proxy network, potentially intensifying volatility in global energy markets.

items.title: 馬斯克力挺美光定價合理！記憶體缺貨恐延續至2028年、HBM市場估值看增
items.title_en: Musk Backs Micron's Pricing as Reasonable! Memory Shortage May Persist Until 2028, HBM Market Valuation Expected to Rise
paras: 隨著全球記憶體市場供不應求，記憶體價格與供應商的定價策略成為市場關注焦點。SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克週二（13日）公開肯定美光科技(MU-US) 的未來記憶體定價策略，認為相較於部分收費過高的供應商，美光採取較合理的定價方式，有助於維持長期客戶關係。
根據《Benzinga》報導，馬斯克在社群平台X發文指出，美光對未來記憶體價格的處理方式相當合理，但其他供應商的收費則高得令人難以接受，客戶不會忘記供應商如何對待他們。
他並認為，美光的做法是維持長期客戶忠誠度的明智策略。
這番言論是回應世界貿易證券（World Trade Securities）執行長兼負責人Nicholas Mugalli在X上的貼文。Mugalli當時分享摩根大通一份看好記憶體與儲存市場的研究報告。
Futurum Equities首席市場策略師Shay Boloor則認為，當供應最終逐漸寬鬆時，美光有機會將馬斯克所說的這種「善意」轉化為更長期的合約，以及更高的市場占有率。
摩根大通表示，記憶體市場的基本面「較90天前明顯強勁許多」，目前需求遠高於供給。
該機構預估，2026年記憶體供應短缺幅度約為20%，2027年為19%，2028年則為15%。
高頻寬記憶體（HBM）市場的成長前景同樣受到看好。摩根大通預估，HBM市場規模將從2026年的約640億美元，擴大至2027年的約1,600億美元，並於2028年進一步攀升至2,800億美元。
在供應合約方面，美光的長期客戶協議數量已從16份增加至26份，這些協議涵蓋至2030年、占公司營收逾35%，剩餘履約義務金額達1,500億美元。
此外，美光2027會計年度超過75%的產出已經獲得承諾。
不過，記憶體產業仍面臨競爭與市場情緒帶來的壓力。週二（13日），半導體類股延續跌勢，市場憂慮中國長鑫科技(688825-CN) 在晶片設計方面取得進展，能夠在更小的空間內整合更多記憶體。
相關疑慮已對主要記憶體企業股價造成衝擊。週一（12日），美光市值蒸發約520億美元，SK海力士(000660KS) 市值減少約415億美元，SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 市值則縮水約150億美元。
股價表現方面， 美光週二下跌3.62%，收在953.19美元，盤後上漲0.32%，報956.20美元。
Benzinga Edge的評級數據顯示，美光股票的動能評分位居第99百分位，品質評分則位居第97百分位。
paras_en: As global memory markets face supply shortages, memory prices and suppliers' pricing strategies have become a focal point. SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk on Tuesday (the 13th) publicly affirmed Micron Technology (MU-US)'s future memory pricing strategy, saying that compared with some overly‑priced suppliers, Micron’s more reasonable pricing helps maintain long‑term customer relationships.

According to Benzinga, Musk posted on X that Micron’s handling of future memory prices is quite reasonable, whereas other suppliers charge levels that are hard to accept, and customers will remember how suppliers treat them.
He added that Micron’s approach is a wise strategy for preserving long‑term customer loyalty.
The comments were in response to a post on X by World Trade Securities CEO and principal Nicholas Mugalli, who had shared a JPMorgan research report bullish on the memory and storage market.
Futurum Equities chief market strategist Shay Boloor said that as supply eventually eases, Micron could turn the “goodwill” Musk described into longer‑term contracts and higher market share.
JPMorgan said the fundamentals of the memory market are “significantly stronger than 90 days ago,” with demand now far exceeding supply.
The firm projects memory supply shortages of about 20% in 2026, 19% in 2027 and 15% in 2028.

The high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) market’s growth outlook is also positive. JPMorgan estimates the HBM market will grow from roughly $64 billion in 2026 to about $160 billion in 2027 and further to $280 billion in 2028.

Regarding supply contracts, Micron’s long‑term customer agreements have risen from 16 to 26, covering through 2030 and representing over 35% of revenue, with remaining performance obligations of $150 billion.
In addition, more than 75% of Micron’s output for fiscal year 2027 is already committed.

However, the memory industry still faces pressure from competition and market sentiment. On Tuesday (the 13th), semiconductor stocks continued to fall as the market worried that China’s ChangXin Technology (688825-CN) was making progress in chip design that could integrate more memory in a smaller footprint.

These concerns have already impacted major memory companies’ stock prices. On Monday (the 12th), Micron’s market value shrank by about $52 billion, SK Hynix (000660KS) lost roughly $41.5 billion, and SanDisk (SNDKV-US) shed about $15 billion in market cap.
In terms of stock performance, Micron fell 3.62% on Tuesday, closing at $953.19, and rose 0.32% in after‑hours trading to $956.20.
Benzinga Edge’s rating data shows Micron’s momentum score is in the 99th percentile, while its quality score sits in the 97th percentile.

items.title: 川普宣布格陵蘭將啟動大規模油氣、礦產探勘
items.title_en: Trump Announces Greenland Will Launch Large-Scale Oil, Gas, and Mineral Exploration
paras: 美國總統川普周三(14日)表示，格陵蘭即將展開「大規模」石油、天然氣及礦產探勘。
川普未透露探勘計畫細節，但表示：「有專家指出，當地易於開採的石油蘊藏量，遠高於全球幾乎任何地方。」
美國、丹麥與格陵蘭上月簽署協議，旨在化解川普多次揚言掌控這座戰略位置重要、礦產資源豐富的島嶼所引發的緊張局勢。
川普在 Truth Social 貼文中還說：「未來任何針對美國的攻擊都必須穿過格陵蘭，而我們的國防系統將在當地常態性攔截無人機、飛彈，甚至是尚未被構想出來的任何新型武器。」
美國、丹麥與格陵蘭簽署的協議擴大美軍在格陵蘭的角色，為設立兩座新軍事基地及部署川普的「金穹」飛彈防禦系統鋪路，同時重申丹麥主權與格陵蘭人民的自決權。
paras_en: US President Trump on Wednesday (the 14th) said Greenland is about to commence "large-scale" oil, natural gas and mineral exploration.
Trump did not disclose details of the exploration plan, but said: "Experts point out that the easily extractable oil reserves there are far greater than almost anywhere else in the world."
The United States, Denmark and Greenland signed an agreement last month aimed at easing tensions caused by Trump’s repeated threats to control this strategically located, resource‑rich island.

In a post on Truth Social, Trump also said: "Any future attack against the United States will have to go through Greenland, and our defense system will regularly intercept drones, missiles, and even any new weapons that have not yet been imagined."

The agreement signed by the US, Denmark and Greenland expands the US military role in Greenland, paving the way for two new bases and the deployment of Trump’s "Gold Dome" missile‑defense system, while reaffirming Denmark's sovereignty and the Greenlandic people's right to self‑determination.

items.title: 美傳奇投資人Baron：SpaceX市值十年後可能達到20兆至50兆美元
items.title_en: Legendary Investor Baron Says SpaceX Could Be Worth $20‑$50 Trillion in Ten Years
paras: 矽谷知名投資人、巴倫資本創辦人Ron Baron近日在哥倫比亞商學院活動中表示，SpaceX十年後市值可能達20兆至50兆美元，股價可望「每股數千美元」，並稱馬斯克覺得這個估計「仍太低」。
這位億萬富翁投資人建議友人持續按月買進SpaceX，若因帳面虧損焦慮，「就找券商再買一些」。Baron還說，SpaceX現階段市值約2.1兆美元，近期股價約156.54美元。
SpaceX成長核心首先看星鏈。Baron估計，星鏈十年後估值約14兆至15兆美元，目前仍處早期，其假設用戶由約1500萬增至3億，年營收由現約150億至170億美元升至1兆美元，EBITDA達7000億至8000億美元。
他並指出，政府、企業與AI代理需求，以及全球偏遠地區連網，是主要放大因子。
另一動能是太空資料中心。Baron稱其規模「可能是未來星鏈的數倍」，理由是地面機房受電力、散熱、用地與民眾抗爭阻礙限制，「地球上已難再大舉興建」；結合星艦低軌發射、星鏈回傳與軌道運算，可繞開部分地面瓶頸。
Baron對投資人喊出「至少20到30倍」回報，但相關預測屬長期假設，仍取決於放量、獲利與監管進度。
paras_en: Silicon Valley investor and founder of Baren Capital Ron Baron told a Columbia Business School event that SpaceX’s market value could reach $20‑$50 trillion in ten years, with a share price potentially “in the thousands of dollars,” and said Elon Musk thinks this estimate is still too low.

The billionaire investor advised friends to keep buying SpaceX shares monthly, and if they feel anxious about paper losses, “just go to a broker and buy more.” Baron also noted that SpaceX’s current market cap is about $2.1 trillion, with a recent share price around $156.54.

Baron said SpaceX’s growth hinges on Starlink. He estimates Starlink could be valued at $14‑$15 trillion in ten years; it is still early, with users projected to rise from about 15 million to 300 million and annual revenue climbing from roughly $15 billion‑$17 billion today to $1 trillion, yielding EBITDA of $700‑$800 billion.
He added that demand from governments, enterprises and AI agents, as well as connectivity for remote areas worldwide, are the main amplification factors.

Another driver is space data centers. Baron claimed their scale “could be several times that of future Starlink,” arguing that terrestrial data centers are limited by power, cooling, land and public opposition, making large new builds on Earth difficult; combining Starship low‑orbit launches, Starlink downlink and orbital computing could bypass some ground bottlenecks.
Baron told investors to expect “at least 20‑30 times” returns, but cautioned that these long‑term forecasts depend on volume growth, profitability and regulatory progress.

items.title: 〈台股盤後〉台塑四寶、被動元件撐盤 尾盤摜壓漲點收斂至284點
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Post‑Market: Formosa Plastics’ Four Treasures and Passive Components Support the Market; Late‑Session Selling Compresses Gains to 284 Points
paras: 台股今 (14) 日反彈，台積電早盤站回2500元，電子權值股台達電、鴻海同步走揚，及台塑四寶等塑化股也有買盤進駐，大盤盤中一度上漲逾700點、重返49000點大關，盤中漲幅收斂。而在最後一盤賣壓下摜156.78點，終場收48625.83點，上漲284.52點，成交量9286.24億元。

台塑四寶第三季自結財報公布後，塑化股續受關注，台塑 (1301-TW)、台化 (1326-TW) 漲停，南亞 (1303-TW) 漲約9%；台塑化 (6505-TW) 收紅。

paras_en: Taiwan stocks rebounded today (the 14th), with TSMC regaining the NT$2,500 level in the early session. Electronics heavyweight stocks Delta Electronics and Foxconn rose together, and the Formosa Plastics “four treasures” plus other petrochemical stocks attracted buying. The index surged more than 700 points mid‑session, briefly retaking the 49,000‑point threshold, before the rally narrowed. In the final session, selling pressure knocked back 156.78 points, closing at 48,625.83, up 284.52 points, with a turnover of NT$928.624 billion.

Electronics heavyweight stocks showed mixed moves: TSMC (2330‑TW) was flat at NT$2,490; MediaTek (2454‑TW) fell NT$50, about 1%; Foxconn (2317‑TW) rose 1%; ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW) gained nearly 1%; Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) rose 0.5%; Quanta Computer (2382‑TW) was unchanged.

After the release of its third‑quarter self‑reported earnings, the petrochemical sector remained in focus. Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) and Formosa Chemical (1326‑TW) hit their daily limits up, Nan Ya (1303‑TW) rose about 9%, and Formosa Chemicals & Fibre (6505‑TW) closed in the green.

Copper‑clad laminate (CCL) stocks saw buying return: Lianmao (6213‑TW) rose about 7%, Tai Yao (6274‑TW) climbed roughly 4%, while Tai Optical (2383‑TW) closed lower.

items.title: 輝達直接出錢鎖產能！京元電(2449)赴美蓋測試廠，450億元投資風險誰承擔？
items.title_en: NVIDIA Directly Pays to Lock Capacity! JY Electronics (2449) Builds Test Facility in the U.S., Who Bears the 45 Billion Dollar Investment Risk?
paras: 2026年10月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI晶片測試產能有多搶？輝達不只下單，現在更直接預付資金，提前鎖定京元電(2449-TW)的美國測試產能。
京元電公告，將與輝達簽訂客戶預付款協議，由輝達先行支付款項，京元電及美國全資子公司AeternZ Semiconductor Testing Corporation則在美國建置產能，為輝達保留產能並提供測試服務，預付款未來再以服務款項逐步抵減。
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)
這代表雙方合作已從一般委外測試，進一步走向「客戶出資、供應商擴產、產能優先保留」的長期綁定模式。不過，輝達預付款並不等於替京元電負擔全部建廠成本，約450億元的美國投資風險，仍須拆成資金、訂單與營運三個層面來看。

輝達為何願意先付錢？
過去晶片測試通常由封測廠自行買進設備、建置無塵室，再依照客戶訂單安排產能；如今輝達願意提前支付款項，反映高階AI晶片測試產能的重要性正在提高。
隨著Blackwell、Rubin等AI晶片功耗及複雜度上升，測試流程不只需要一般成品測試，還可能加入高功率Burn-in、SLT系統級測試及液冷環境測試。晶片愈複雜，測試時間愈長，占用設備的時間也愈多，客戶若不提前卡位，未來即使晶片生產完成，也可能受限於後段測試產能。
因此，輝達願意提供預付款，目的不只是支持京元電赴美設廠，更重要的是提前取得產能保障，降低新一代AI晶片量產時面臨測試瓶頸的風險。

預付款不是營收，而是未來服務的訂金
這份協議最容易被誤解的地方，是把輝達預付款直接視為京元電的當期營收或獲利。
實際上，輝達支付的款項，初期較可能先列為京元電的合約負債或預收款項。未來京元電完成設備建置並提供晶片測試服務後，才能按照服務進度抵減預付款、逐步認列營收。
因此，這項協議對京元電最大的幫助，不是立刻增加EPS，而是降低「廠蓋好了卻沒有足夠訂單」的風險。

450億元投資風險，誰來承擔？
京元電先前已通過美國投資設廠案，投資額度最高14億美元，折合新台幣約450億元，是公司近年規模最大的海外投資。此次獲得輝達預付款，確實能減輕部分資金壓力，但不代表所有風險都轉由輝達承擔。
大致可以分成三類：

訂單風險降低：輝達願意提前付款並保留產能，代表美國廠已有明確客戶需求支撐。
資金風險部分降低：預付款可協助支應部分建置需求，減少完全依靠自有資金或借款的壓力。
建廠與營運風險仍由京元電承擔：工程進度、設備採購、人力成本、良率爬坡及後續折舊，原則上仍會反映在京元電財務報表上。

此外，京元電尚未公布輝達預付款金額、占整體建廠成本比重及最低採購承諾，因此目前不能直接推論輝達將負擔全部450億元投資，也無法確定新廠的產能利用率已獲完全保證。

京元電今年已砸500億元擴產
除了美國廠，京元電2026年資本支出也由原先規劃的393.72億元，上修至500億元，創下歷史新高，主要用於擴充AI GPU、ASIC及高功率Burn-in測試產能。
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)
從營收來看，相關投資已逐步反映在業績。京元電9月營收40.71億元，年增24.46%；第三季營收121.42億元，季增8.98%、年增30.69%，創下單季新高；前九月累計營收334.76億元，年增34.08%。
(圖片來源:優分析產業資料庫)
目前京元電的AI測試需求已從輝達GPU，擴散至Google TPU、AWS及Meta等ASIC專案。隨著頭份、楊梅新產能陸續開出，以及Rubin平台逐步放量，2027年仍是新產能轉化為營收的重要觀察期。

客戶出錢擴產，仍有兩項隱憂
輝達預付款雖然提高訂單確定性，但也可能帶來客戶集中度上升的問題。若美國新廠多數產能專門保留給輝達，京元電的設備配置、產能利用率及議價能力，都會更受到單一客戶產品週期影響。
另一項風險則是美國生產成本。當地廠房、人力與營運費用普遍高於台灣，即使新廠順利量產，毛利率能否維持，仍須觀察客戶報價是否足以反映增加的成本，以及產能利用率能否快速拉升。
整體而言，輝達預付款等於替京元電的美國擴產提供「訂單背書」，讓原本約450億元的海外投資，從京元電單方面押注，轉變為客戶共同參與的產能布局。
但這筆款項不是免費資金，也不是立即入帳的獲利。輝達主要承擔提前鎖定產能的資金承諾，京元電仍須承擔建廠、折舊、成本與量產執行風險；真正的驗收點，在於美國廠投產後，能否把訂單能見度轉化為營收及獲利。

paras_en: October 14, 2026 (Yuan Analysis / Industry Data Center Report) – How competitive is AI chip test capacity? NVIDIA not only places orders, but now also pre‑pays funds to lock in JY Electronics (2449‑TW) U.S. test capacity ahead of time.

JY Electronics announced it will sign a customer pre‑payment agreement with NVIDIA, whereby NVIDIA will pay first. JY Electronics and its wholly‑owned U.S. subsidiary AeternZ Semiconductor Testing Corporation will then build capacity in the U.S., reserve capacity for NVIDIA, and provide test services. The pre‑payment will later be gradually offset against service fees.
(Image source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)

This means the partnership has moved from ordinary outsourcing testing to a long‑term binding model of "customer funding, supplier expansion, and priority capacity retention." However, NVIDIA’s pre‑payment does not mean it bears all the plant‑building costs. The roughly 45 billion‑dollar U.S. investment risk still needs to be viewed in terms of finance, orders, and operations.

Why is NVIDIA willing to pay first? Traditionally, chip test facilities buy equipment, build clean rooms, and schedule capacity based on customer orders. NVIDIA’s willingness to pay upfront reflects the growing importance of high‑end AI chip test capacity.

With AI chips like Blackwell and Rubin increasing power consumption and complexity, the test process requires not only standard finished‑product testing but also high‑power burn‑in, SLT system‑level testing, and liquid‑cooling environment testing. The more complex the chip, the longer the test time and the more equipment time consumed. If customers do not secure capacity early, even after chip production, they may still be limited by downstream test capacity.

Therefore, NVIDIA’s pre‑payment is not just to support JY Electronics’ U.S. plant construction; it is mainly to secure capacity in advance and reduce the risk of test bottlenecks when the next generation of AI chips goes into mass production.
The pre‑payment is not revenue but a deposit for future services. The most common misunderstanding is to treat NVIDIA’s pre‑payment as JY Electronics’ current revenue or profit.

In reality, the payment is likely initially recorded as a contract liability or prepaid revenue for JY Electronics. Only after the equipment is built and chip testing services are provided can the pre‑payment be offset against service progress and gradually recognized as revenue.
Thus, the biggest benefit of this agreement for JY Electronics is not an immediate EPS boost but a reduction in the risk of "building a plant with insufficient orders."

Who bears the 45 billion‑dollar investment risk? JY Electronics previously secured a U.S. investment project with a maximum investment of 1.4 billion USD, roughly 45 billion NTD, the largest overseas investment in recent years. NVIDIA’s pre‑payment can ease some financial pressure, but it does not mean all risk is transferred to NVIDIA.

The risk can be roughly divided into three categories: 1) Order risk reduction: NVIDIA’s upfront payment and capacity reservation indicate clear customer demand for the U.S. plant. 2) Financial risk reduction: the pre‑payment helps cover part of the build‑out cost, easing reliance on self‑funding or borrowing. 3) Construction and operational risk remains with JY Electronics: engineering schedule, equipment procurement, labor costs, yield ramp‑up, and subsequent depreciation will still appear in JY Electronics’ financial statements.

Additionally, JY Electronics has not disclosed the exact amount of NVIDIA’s pre‑payment, its proportion of the total plant cost, or the minimum purchase commitment, so it cannot be inferred that NVIDIA will cover the entire 45 billion‑dollar investment or that the new plant’s capacity utilization is fully guaranteed.

JY Electronics has already spent 50 billion NTD on expansion this year. In addition to the U.S. plant, the company raised its 2026 capital expenditure from an originally planned 39.372 billion NTD to 50 billion NTD, a record high, mainly to expand AI GPU, ASIC, and high‑power burn‑in test capacity.
(Image source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)

From a revenue perspective, the related investment is gradually reflected in performance. JY Electronics’ September revenue was 4.071 billion NTD, up 24.46% YoY; Q3 revenue was 12.142 billion NTD, up 8.98% QoQ and 30.69% YoY, a new quarterly high; cumulative revenue for the first nine months was 33.476 billion NTD, up 34.08% YoY.
(Image source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)

Currently, JY Electronics’ AI test demand has expanded from NVIDIA GPUs to Google TPU, AWS, and Meta ASIC projects. With new capacity at Toufen and Yangmei coming online and the Rubin platform gradually scaling up, 2027 remains an important period to observe new capacity translating into revenue.

Two hidden concerns remain with customer‑funded expansion. NVIDIA’s pre‑payment increases order certainty but may also raise customer concentration. If most of the U.S. plant’s capacity is reserved for NVIDIA, JY Electronics’ equipment allocation, capacity utilization, and bargaining power will be more affected by a single customer’s product cycle.

Another risk is U.S. production cost. Local plant, labor, and operating expenses are generally higher than in Taiwan. Even if the new plant achieves mass production, whether gross margin can be maintained depends on whether customer pricing reflects the increased cost and whether capacity utilization can rise quickly.

Overall, NVIDIA’s pre‑payment provides a "order endorsement" for JY Electronics’ U.S. expansion, turning the roughly 45 billion‑dollar overseas investment from a unilateral bet into a capacity layout shared with a customer.

However, this money is not free or immediate profit. NVIDIA mainly bears the commitment to lock capacity in advance; JY Electronics still bears plant construction, depreciation, cost, and mass‑production execution risk. The real milestone is whether the U.S. plant can convert order visibility into revenue and profit after production.

items.title: 仁寶OCP秀800VDC與MW級液冷技術AI伺服器跨足L11機櫃整合，2027年營收占比拚40%
items.title_en: Inventec OCP Showcases 800VDC and MW-Scale Liquid Cooling AI Servers Crossing Into L11 Cabinet Integration, Targeting 40% Revenue Share by 2027
paras: 2026年10月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 仁寶(2324-TW)於2026年OCP全球高峰會展示新一代AI資料中心基礎設施，聚焦800V高壓直流供電（800VDC）、MW（百萬瓦）級電力與液冷散熱系統，結合高密度AI伺服器及機櫃級設計。隨著AI伺服器功耗持續攀升，仁寶正將業務從L6主機板組裝延伸至L10系統整合及L11機櫃級交付，擴大在AI供應鏈的參與程度。
仁寶自2026年第1季起，開始向新興雲端業者（Neocloud）交付搭載輝達Nvidia(NVDA-US) HGX B300的L10伺服器，帶動伺服器營收占比由2025年的1%至2%，提高至第1季的5%，第2季進一步升至約8%，其中AI伺服器占伺服器業務營收約70%至80%。公司目標2026年伺服器營收占比達10%，2027年進一步提高至30%至40%。
技術方面，仁寶此次展示800VDC供電方案，透過提高電壓降低大電流傳輸損耗，並減少部分電力轉換環節，搭配MW級液冷基礎設施，支援高密度GPU運算叢集。輝達也在本屆OCP峰會開放Vera Rubin機櫃與運算托盤設計，最新MGX 1.2規範納入機櫃級液冷及5,000A液冷匯流排，最高支援250kW機櫃功率。
仁寶目前已取得輝達MGX、超微AMD(AMD-US) MI325等平台認證，並通過Vera及Rubin運算托盤認證，但完整Vera Rubin機櫃仍受現有廠房電力條件限制，尚待完成相關驗證。
為支援機櫃級業務擴張，仁寶投資40.3億元的大溪廠已於今年8月啟用，預計第4季逐步貢獻營收，2027年下半年達到滿載。美國德州兩座新廠則規劃2026年第4季試產、2027年第1季量產，涵蓋L6至L11製程；越南廠也計畫將SMT產線由4條擴充至10條，支援伺服器主機板生產。

paras_en: On October 14, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Inventec (2324-TW) displayed its next‑generation AI data‑center infrastructure at the 2026 OCP Global Summit, focusing on 800‑volt high‑voltage DC power (800VDC), megawatt‑scale power and liquid‑cooling systems, combined with high‑density AI servers and cabinet‑level design. As AI server power consumption continues to rise, Inventec is extending its business from L6 motherboard assembly to L10 system integration and L11 cabinet‑level delivery, expanding its participation in the AI supply chain.

Inventec began delivering L10 servers equipped with Nvidia (NVDA-US) HGX B300 to emerging cloud provider Neocloud starting in Q1 2026, driving server‑revenue share up from 1%‑2% in 2025 to 5% in Q1 and about 8% in Q2, with AI servers accounting for roughly 70%‑80% of server‑business revenue. The company aims for server revenue to represent 10% of total revenue in 2026 and to increase that to 30%‑40% in 2027.

Technically, Inventec showcased an 800VDC power solution that raises voltage to reduce large‑current transmission loss and cuts some power‑conversion steps, paired with megawatt‑scale liquid‑cooling infrastructure to support high‑density GPU compute clusters. Nvidia also opened its Vera Rubin cabinet and compute‑tray designs at the OCP summit, with the latest MGX 1.2 specification incorporating cabinet‑level liquid cooling and a 5,000 A liquid‑cooling busbar, supporting up to 250 kW per cabinet.

Inventec has already obtained certifications for Nvidia MGX, AMD (AMD-US) MI325 and other platforms, and has passed Vera and Rubin compute‑tray certifications, but the full Vera Rubin cabinet is still limited by existing plant power conditions and awaits further validation.

To support the expansion of cabinet‑level business, Inventec’s Da‑xi plant, with a 4.03 billion‑NTD investment, was commissioned in August this year and is expected to contribute revenue gradually from Q4, reaching full capacity in the second half of 2027. Two new plants in Texas, USA are slated for trial production in Q4 2026 and mass production in Q1 2027, covering processes from L6 to L11; the Vietnam plant also plans to expand its SMT lines from four to ten to support server motherboard production.

items.title_en: Jiaji (6715) August Revenue Up 113.01% YoY, Optical Communication New Products Target 2027 Volume, MT Ferrule Becomes Clear New Growth Driver
paras: 2026年10月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 嘉基2026年營運起伏劇烈，第一季毛利率衝上40.01%，第二季因消費性市場疲弱、ReDriver IC缺貨與原物料成本上升，毛利率降至23.24%並轉虧。
不過8月營收1.65億元，年增113.01%，累計年增轉正至10.24%，同時光通訊新品布局逐步成形，公司2027年將是轉型落地的關鍵年。
MT Ferrule 2027年第一季開始出貨，營收占比預估達38%
真正值得注意的是，公司已具備0.3微米高精度產能，月產能約100萬顆，第四季將把0.3微米以下的月產能拉升至70萬至80萬顆以上。
MT Ferrule預計2027年第一季開始出貨，營收占比預估達38%，毛利率略優於過往平均，法人估可貢獻十餘億元營收。
光纖出現結構性缺貨，國際大廠向外尋找替代夥伴，為嘉基創造了切入的機會。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)
NPO Socket與美系光通訊大廠合作，2027年下半年小量出貨
公司與美系光通訊大廠合作開發6.4T規格的NPO Socket，採32通道、每通道200G設計，預計年底前推出原型，2027年下半年小量出貨，2028年放量。
公司已成為該客戶推動6.4T光模組的核心夥伴，目前處理器平台與雲端業者的原型機正在測試中；400G線性驅動光模組已小量生產，800G則送樣確認中。
現增18.6億元已收足，中壢廠2027年底新產線投產
公司現金增資6,000張，發行價310元，募資18.6億元，已於9月17日全數收足。
中壢廠無塵室預計2027年第二季完成整建，新產線2027年第四季投產，為光通訊新品量產預作準備。
風險提醒：毛利率回升速度與新品放量時程仍待驗證
公司2025年12月曾表示新產品2026年上半年逐步放量，但第二季毛利率反而驟降並轉虧，顯示預期與實際存在落差。
短線須觀察第三、四季毛利率能否隨主動元件出貨回溫，中長線則要看MT Ferrule出貨與NPO Socket認證進度是否如期。

paras_en: October 14, 2026 (You Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Jiaji’s 2026 operations have been highly volatile, with Q1 gross margin soaring to 40.01%, but Q2 dropping to 23.24% and turning negative due to a weak consumer market, a shortage of ReDriver ICs, and rising raw material costs.

However, August revenue reached NT$165 million, up 113.01% year‑over‑year, bringing cumulative annual growth back into positive territory at 10.24%. At the same time, the rollout of new optical‑communication products is gradually taking shape, making 2027 a pivotal year for the company’s transformation.
MT Ferrule shipments are slated to begin in Q1 2027, expected to account for about 38% of revenue.
Notably, the company now has 0.3‑micron high‑precision capacity, roughly 1 million units per month, and plans to raise sub‑0.3‑micron monthly capacity to 700,000‑800,000 units in Q4.

MT Ferrule is expected to start shipping in Q1 2027, projected to contribute about 38% of revenue, with a gross margin slightly above the historical average; analysts estimate it could add over NT$1 billion in revenue.
A structural shortage of optical fiber has led major international manufacturers to seek alternative partners, creating an entry opportunity for Jiaji.
Image source: You Analysis Industry Database
NPO Socket is cooperating with a U.S. optical‑communication giant, with small shipments planned for the second half of 2027.

The company is working with the U.S. optical‑communication leader to develop a 6.4‑Terabit NPO Socket, using a 32‑channel, 200 Gb per channel design. A prototype is expected by year‑end, with limited shipments in H2 2027 and volume production in 2028.

Jiaji has become a core partner for the customer’s 6.4‑Terabit optical module, and prototype devices for processor platforms and cloud providers are currently under test; 400 Gb linear‑drive optical modules are in low‑volume production, while 800 Gb units are in sample‑verification stage.
An additional NT$1.86 billion has been fully raised, and a new production line at the Zhongli plant will be operational by the end of 2027.
The company raised capital by issuing 6,000 shares at NT$310 each, collecting NT$1.86 billion, which was fully subscribed on September 17.

The cleanroom at the Zhongli plant is expected to be completed in Q2 2027, with the new production line coming online in Q4 2027 to prepare for mass production of the new optical‑communication products.
Risk reminder: the speed of gross‑margin recovery and the timing of new‑product volume ramp‑up remain unverified.

The company indicated in December 2025 that new products would gradually scale in the first half of 2026, but gross margin sharply fell and turned negative in Q2, showing a gap between expectations and reality.

In the short term, watch whether gross margins improve in Q3 and Q4 as active component shipments recover; in the medium to long term, monitor whether MT Ferrule shipments and NPO Socket certification progress as scheduled.

items.title: 聯茂(6213)今日大漲7%！原料瓶頸解除，CCL漲價效益延續，下一波獲利驅動力即將出現
items.title_en: Lian Mao (6213) Soars 7% Today! Raw Material Bottleneck Eased, CCL Price Gains Continue, Next Profit Driver Emerging
paras: 2026年10月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 聯茂(6213-TW)今(14)日股價走強，盤中上漲逾7%，最高觸及856元。除了高階銅箔基板(CCL)供需緊俏、產品報價持續上漲，市場也開始關注上游原料供應改善後，出貨量能否進一步增加。
聯茂第三季營收達156.2億元，季增35.4%，優於預期，受惠E-glass玻纖布供應吃緊，第三季M6以下CCL漲幅達30%，預期第四季整體產品線仍有20%以上的漲價空間。
值得注意的是，聯茂第三季產能利用率僅70～75%，限制出貨的主因並非需求不足，而是上游原料短缺。 隨中國E-glass廠新增產能逐步開出，第四季稼動率有望回升至75%以上。
這代表聯茂接下來的成長動力，可能從單純依靠漲價，進一步轉向價格與出貨量同步增加。若原料供應改善速度優於預期，帶動有效產能提升，同時CCL仍維持較高報價，將成為後續營收及EPS上修的潛在來源。

paras_en: October 14, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Lian Mao (6213‑TW) saw its stock rally today, climbing more than 7% intraday and peaking at NT$856. In addition to tight supply‑demand for high‑end copper‑clad laminate (CCL) and ongoing price hikes, the market is now watching whether shipments can rise further as upstream raw‑material supplies improve.

Lian Mao posted third‑quarter revenue of NT$15.62 billion, up 35.4% quarter‑over‑quarter and beating expectations, helped by a tight supply of E‑glass fiber cloth. CCL below M6 saw a 30% price increase in Q3, and the company expects over 20% pricing room across its product line in Q4.

It is noteworthy that Lian Mao’s Q3 capacity utilization was only 70‑75%, with the main constraint on shipments being upstream material shortages rather than weak demand. As new capacity at Chinese E‑glass plants comes online, utilization is expected to rise above 75% in Q4.

This suggests that Lian Mao’s next growth engine may shift from relying solely on price hikes to a combination of higher prices and increased shipment volumes. If raw‑material supply improves faster than expected, effective capacity will rise while CCL prices remain high, providing a potential source for future revenue and EPS upgrades.
