晶華表示，重慶麗晶酒店2017年開幕至今，由於住房、餐飲、軟硬體服務各方面皆有卓越表現，連年榮登攜程最受歡迎酒店和奢華酒店榜單，近日更獲米其林一星鑰酒店肯定。
由於重慶麗晶位處當地商業金融中心，隨著直航航班重啟，晶華也推出四天三夜入住江景客房、享行政酒廊禮遇以及雙人自助晚餐和每日早餐的優惠專案，兩人成行每房價格25,000元起。
重慶麗晶設有202間客房，館內設計將重慶著名的「山」、「城」、「江」等景致融入各個空間，並穿插「屋瓦」、「夏布」、「山茶花」、「兵工廠」、「辣椒」等人文藝術元素。
而飯店內也設有3間餐廳和2間酒吧，其中，「羅賓斯牛排館」連續六年蟬聯黑珍珠餐廳榜單，是重慶唯一一家上榜的西餐廳；「渝廚房」則以豐富的亞洲料理為主、國際美食為輔，提供自助餐和單點服務；而「麗晶軒」則專注於地道川菜及粵菜。
paras_en: With China Airlines (2610‑TW) ending a six‑year hiatus by restarting its scheduled Taoyuan‑to‑Chongqing direct flight on October 28, offering more convenient transport for business travelers, Regent Hotels (2707‑TW) announced on the 14th a promotional package for its Chongqing Regent Hotel aimed at capturing high‑end clientele.

Regent said that since the Chongqing Regent Hotel opened in 2017, its rooms, dining, and both soft‑ and hard‑service have consistently performed excellently, earning repeated spots on Ctrip’s most popular and luxury hotel lists, and most recently receiving a Michelin‑starred “Key Hotel” endorsement.

Because the hotel is located in Chongqing’s commercial‑financial hub, Regent is launching a four‑day, three‑night package that includes a river‑view room, executive lounge privileges, a double‑buffet dinner and daily breakfast, priced from NT$25,000 per room for two guests.

The Chongqing Regent features 202 rooms, with interior design that weaves the city’s iconic “mountain,” “city,” and “river” scenery into every space, and incorporates cultural‑art elements such as roof tiles, summer cloth, camellias, munitions factories, and chilies.

The property houses three restaurants and two bars: “Robins Steakhouse,” which has topped the Black Pearl restaurant list for six consecutive years and is the only Western‑style restaurant in Chongqing to make the list; “Yu Kitchen,” offering a rich Asian buffet complemented by international à la carte dishes; and “Regent Xuan,” which specializes in authentic Sichuan and Cantonese cuisine.

items.title: 每年採購600萬噸阿拉斯加天然氣 經濟部回應證實20年台美能源合作計畫
items.title_en: Taiwan to Purchase 6 Million Tons of Alaska LNG Annually, MOEA Confirms 20-Year Taiwan‑US Energy Cooperation Plan
paras: 針對美國總統川普於當地時間13日在阿拉斯加州的造勢活動中，公開宣布台灣已同意在未來20年內採購阿拉斯加液化天然氣（Alaska LNG）計畫產量的30%，並承諾加碼投資44億美元（約合新台幣1390億元）推動大型能源專案，引發國際高度關注。對此，經濟部今（14）日正式回應表示，為確保國內天然氣穩定供應，台灣始終秉持氣源多元化採購策略，自去年3月台灣中油於台北簽署「阿拉斯加液化天然氣買賣暨投資意向書（LOI）」以來，經過近一年半的密集協商及審慎評估，目前專案已與美國開發商取得重大進展。
經濟部說明，依目前規劃方向，雙方合作重點涵蓋開採後每年採購600萬噸阿拉斯加液化天然氣，以及參與專案開發，預估整體投資金額最高可達44億美元。透過長期的能源採購與專案投資並行，不僅能有效促進國內天然氣供應的多元性，更能大幅提升供應調度彈性，進一步強化台灣整體的能源韌性，同時深化台美經貿與戰略合作夥伴關係。
在運輸與地理優勢方面，經濟部指出，阿拉斯加液化天然氣計畫具備獨特的地理位置優越性，未來可透過太平洋航線直接運送抵達台灣，這對於分散天然氣運輸路線、降低地緣政治帶來的供應風險具有關鍵助益。若各項計畫能依照預期規劃期程順利推進，預計最快可自2032年起進一步挹注國內天然氣供應，成為台灣持續推動氣源分散與能源轉型的重要中長期布局。
面對外界關注的美方宣布事項與後續執行細節，經濟部強調，相關合作將持續秉持互惠共榮及專業原則推進。台灣中油將持續與美方相關單位就採購、投資及具體合作事項進行密切協調，並依公司內部程序辦理專案研究及預算報核作業。未來的具體投資安排、持股比例及商業條件，都將依照雙方後續的實質協商與商業契約相關程序辦理，藉此穩健擴展公司營運版圖，並全面回應國內日益成長的能源供應需求。
經濟部重申，國家能源安全是社會穩定與經濟發展的絕對基石，面對全球能源市場的瞬息萬變，政府未來將持續密切關注全球天然氣市場動態及各項開發計畫的推動情形。透過堅定的多元化採購策略，並隨時滾動檢討國內用氣規劃，全力確保國內能源穩定供應，為台灣的永續發展與產業競爭力提供最強而有力的後盾。
paras_en: In response to U.S. President Trump’s public announcement on the 13th local time in Alaska that Taiwan has agreed to purchase 30% of the output of the Alaska LNG project over the next 20 years and to commit an additional $4.4 billion (about NT$1.39 trillion) to a large‑scale energy project, the Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) issued an official statement on the 14th. The ministry said that to ensure a stable domestic gas supply, Taiwan has always pursued a diversified gas‑sourcing strategy. Since Taiwan’s CPC signed an Alaska LNG purchase and investment Letter of Intent in Taipei in March last year, intensive negotiations and careful assessments over the past year and a half have led to significant progress with the U.S. developer.

The MOEA explained that under the current plan the cooperation will focus on purchasing 6 million tonnes of Alaska LNG each year after extraction and participating in project development, with total investment potentially reaching up to $4.4 billion. By combining long‑term gas procurement with project investment, Taiwan can not only diversify its gas supply but also greatly improve dispatch flexibility, strengthen overall energy resilience, and deepen Taiwan‑U.S. trade and strategic partnership.

Regarding transport and geographic advantages, the ministry noted that the Alaska LNG project enjoys a unique location that allows direct shipment to Taiwan via Pacific routes. This would diversify transport corridors and reduce supply risks linked to geopolitical tensions. If the schedule proceeds as planned, the first gas deliveries could begin as early as 2032, forming a key mid‑ to long‑term component of Taiwan’s effort to diversify gas sources and transition its energy mix.

Addressing external interest in the U.S. announcement and implementation details, the MOEA stressed that the cooperation will continue to be guided by mutual benefit, professionalism and reciprocity. CPC will keep close coordination with U.S. counterparts on procurement, investment and concrete cooperation matters, and will follow internal procedures for project studies and budget approvals. Specific investment amounts, equity stakes and commercial terms will be settled through subsequent substantive negotiations and contractual processes, enabling a steady expansion of the company’s operations and fully meeting Taiwan’s growing energy demand.

The ministry reiterated that national energy security underpins social stability and economic development. Facing a rapidly changing global energy market, the government will keep a close watch on worldwide gas market trends and the progress of development projects. Through a firm diversified procurement strategy and continual review of domestic gas planning, the government aims to ensure stable energy supply and provide a strong foundation for Taiwan’s sustainable development and industrial competitiveness.

items.title: 艾司摩爾AI需求旺到2030年！第三季獲利超預期、EUV設備產能吃緊
items.title_en: ASML AI Demand Strong Through 2030! Q3 Profit Beats Expectations, EUV Equipment Capacity Tight
paras: 全球半導體設備龍頭艾司摩爾(ASML-US) 指出，部分客戶已開始表達對2029年、甚至2030年下單採購關鍵半導體設備的興趣，顯示人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮帶動的晶片需求，正進一步延伸至未來數年。艾司摩爾第三季獲利優於市場預期，也為關注其長期成長動能的投資人帶來支撐。
根據《CNBC》報導，艾司摩爾執行長Christophe Fouquet在聲明中表示，客戶持續上修短期與中期設備需求預測，主要受到AI相關投資規模及持續時間預期的影響。
他進一步指出：「考慮到客戶對需求的掌握程度，部分客戶已表達有意向我們下訂2029年、甚至2030年的設備。」
艾司摩爾是全球唯一能生產極紫外光（EUV）微影設備的公司。這類設備是製造最先進半導體的關鍵工具，台積電(2330-TW) 等晶片製造商仰賴相關技術推進先進製程，因此艾司摩爾的財報與訂單展望，一直是投資人觀察AI晶片需求的重要指標。
Fouquet也指出，艾司摩爾目前規劃在2027年與2028年提供的設備產能，仍不足以完全滿足客戶需求。公司正研究擴產方式，希望讓2028年的產能增幅超越先前預估的30%。
本季期間，全球兩大晶片製造商三星電子(005930KS) 與台積電均承諾採用艾司摩爾的高數值孔徑（High NA）極紫外光（EUV）微影設備。
High NA EUV是艾司摩爾的新一代設備，分析師認為，這項技術將是推動該公司未來成長的關鍵。
今年7月，由於設備需求持續強勁，艾司摩爾上修全年銷售額及毛利率預測。該公司股價今年以來已上漲56%。
艾司摩爾週三（14日）縮小全年營收預測區間，並表示目前預估全年淨銷售額將介於440億至450億歐元（493億至504億美元）之間。先前預測區間的下限為430億歐元。
艾司摩爾也預估，第四季淨銷售額將介於142億至152億歐元之間，預測區間上限高於倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）分析師142億歐元的共識預估。
艾司摩爾第三季淨利達49.6億歐元，明顯高於LSEG預期的41億歐元；不過，單季淨銷售額為116.6億歐元，略低於LSEG預估的117.2億歐元。
paras_en: Global semiconductor equipment leader ASML (ASML-US) said that some customers have already begun expressing interest in placing orders for key semiconductor equipment for 2029 and even 2030, indicating that the chip demand driven by the AI investment boom is extending further into the coming years. ASML's third‑quarter profit exceeded market expectations, providing support for investors focused on its long‑term growth momentum.

According to a CNBC report, ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet said in a statement that customers are continuously revising up their short‑ and medium‑term equipment demand forecasts, mainly due to expectations about the scale and duration of AI‑related investments.
He added, "Given the level of insight customers have into demand, some have indicated an intention to place orders with us for equipment in 2029 and even 2030."

ASML is the only company in the world that can produce extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography machines. These tools are critical for manufacturing the most advanced semiconductors, and chipmakers such as TSMC (2330‑TW) rely on the technology to advance their leading‑edge processes, making ASML's earnings and order outlook a key gauge of AI chip demand for investors.

Fouquet also noted that the equipment capacity ASML plans to provide in 2027 and 2028 is still insufficient to fully meet customer demand. The company is studying ways to expand production, aiming for a capacity increase in 2028 that exceeds the previously forecasted 30% growth.
During the quarter, the world’s two largest chip manufacturers, Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and TSMC, both pledged to adopt ASML’s High‑NA (high numerical aperture) EUV lithography equipment.
High‑NA EUV is ASML’s next‑generation system, and analysts believe this technology will be a key driver of the company’s future growth.
In July, due to continued strong equipment demand, ASML raised its full‑year sales and gross‑margin forecasts. The company’s share price has risen 56% so far this year.

On Wednesday (the 14th), ASML narrowed its full‑year revenue guidance, stating that it now expects net sales for the year to be between €44 billion and €45 billion (US$49.3 billion to US$50.4 billion). The lower bound of the previous range was €43 billion.

ASML also projected fourth‑quarter net sales to be between €14.2 billion and €15.2 billion, with the upper end of the range above the consensus estimate of €14.2 billion from London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) analysts.
ASML’s third‑quarter net profit reached €4.96 billion, well above LSEG’s forecast of €4.1 billion; however, quarterly net sales were €11.66 billion, slightly below LSEG’s estimate of €11.72 billion.

items.title: 馬斯克力挺美光定價合理！記憶體缺貨恐延續至2028年、HBM市場估值看增
items.title_en: Musk Backs Micron's Pricing as Reasonable! Memory Shortage May Persist Until 2028, HBM Market Valuation Expected to Rise
paras: 隨著全球記憶體市場供不應求，記憶體價格與供應商的定價策略成為市場關注焦點。SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克週二（13日）公開肯定美光科技(MU-US) 的未來記憶體定價策略，認為相較於部分收費過高的供應商，美光採取較合理的定價方式，有助於維持長期客戶關係。
根據《Benzinga》報導，馬斯克在社群平台X發文指出，美光對未來記憶體價格的處理方式相當合理，但其他供應商的收費則高得令人難以接受，客戶不會忘記供應商如何對待他們。
他並認為，美光的做法是維持長期客戶忠誠度的明智策略。
這番言論是回應世界貿易證券（World Trade Securities）執行長兼負責人Nicholas Mugalli在X上的貼文。Mugalli當時分享摩根大通一份看好記憶體與儲存市場的研究報告。
Futurum Equities首席市場策略師Shay Boloor則認為，當供應最終逐漸寬鬆時，美光有機會將馬斯克所說的這種「善意」轉化為更長期的合約，以及更高的市場占有率。
摩根大通表示，記憶體市場的基本面「較90天前明顯強勁許多」，目前需求遠高於供給。
該機構預估，2026年記憶體供應短缺幅度約為20%，2027年為19%，2028年則為15%。
高頻寬記憶體（HBM）市場的成長前景同樣受到看好。摩根大通預估，HBM市場規模將從2026年的約640億美元，擴大至2027年的約1,600億美元，並於2028年進一步攀升至2,800億美元。
在供應合約方面，美光的長期客戶協議數量已從16份增加至26份，這些協議涵蓋至2030年、占公司營收逾35%，剩餘履約義務金額達1,500億美元。
此外，美光2027會計年度超過75%的產出已經獲得承諾。
不過，記憶體產業仍面臨競爭與市場情緒帶來的壓力。週二（13日），半導體類股延續跌勢，市場憂慮中國長鑫科技(688825-CN) 在晶片設計方面取得進展，能夠在更小的空間內整合更多記憶體。
相關疑慮已對主要記憶體企業股價造成衝擊。週一（12日），美光市值蒸發約520億美元，SK海力士(000660KS) 市值減少約415億美元，SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 市值則縮水約150億美元。
股價表現方面， 美光週二下跌3.62%，收在953.19美元，盤後上漲0.32%，報956.20美元。
Benzinga Edge的評級數據顯示，美光股票的動能評分位居第99百分位，品質評分則位居第97百分位。
paras_en: As global memory markets face supply shortages, memory prices and suppliers' pricing strategies have become a focal point. SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk on Tuesday (the 13th) publicly affirmed Micron Technology (MU-US)'s future memory pricing strategy, saying that compared with some overly‑priced suppliers, Micron’s more reasonable pricing helps maintain long‑term customer relationships.

According to Benzinga, Musk posted on X that Micron’s handling of future memory prices is quite reasonable, whereas other suppliers charge levels that are hard to accept, and customers will remember how suppliers treat them.
He added that Micron’s approach is a wise strategy for preserving long‑term customer loyalty.
The comments were in response to a post on X by World Trade Securities CEO and principal Nicholas Mugalli, who had shared a JPMorgan research report bullish on the memory and storage market.
Futurum Equities chief market strategist Shay Boloor said that as supply eventually eases, Micron could turn the “goodwill” Musk described into longer‑term contracts and higher market share.
JPMorgan said the fundamentals of the memory market are “significantly stronger than 90 days ago,” with demand now far exceeding supply.
The firm projects memory supply shortages of about 20% in 2026, 19% in 2027 and 15% in 2028.

The high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) market’s growth outlook is also positive. JPMorgan estimates the HBM market will grow from roughly $64 billion in 2026 to about $160 billion in 2027 and further to $280 billion in 2028.

Regarding supply contracts, Micron’s long‑term customer agreements have risen from 16 to 26, covering through 2030 and representing over 35% of revenue, with remaining performance obligations of $150 billion.
In addition, more than 75% of Micron’s output for fiscal year 2027 is already committed.

However, the memory industry still faces pressure from competition and market sentiment. On Tuesday (the 13th), semiconductor stocks continued to fall as the market worried that China’s ChangXin Technology (688825-CN) was making progress in chip design that could integrate more memory in a smaller footprint.

These concerns have already impacted major memory companies’ stock prices. On Monday (the 12th), Micron’s market value shrank by about $52 billion, SK Hynix (000660KS) lost roughly $41.5 billion, and SanDisk (SNDKV-US) shed about $15 billion in market cap.
In terms of stock performance, Micron fell 3.62% on Tuesday, closing at $953.19, and rose 0.32% in after‑hours trading to $956.20.
Benzinga Edge’s rating data shows Micron’s momentum score is in the 99th percentile, while its quality score sits in the 97th percentile.

items.title: Muse Wonder搞砸會怎樣？Meta財務長私下警告恐釀財務危機
items.title_en: What Happens If Muse Wonder Fails? Meta CFO Quietly Warns of Potential Financial Crisis
paras: Meta(META-US) AI 負責人亞歷山大王（Alexandr Wang）近日透露，在頂尖AI 模型尚未完成技術驗證之際，執行長祖克柏便拍板投入 1000 億至 2000 億美元建置基礎設施。這場豪賭也讓財務長蘇珊李（Susan Li）鄭重警告，若模型研發失敗，公司將面臨非常嚴重的財務後果。
亞歷山大王與祖克柏近日一同接受 Stripe 共同創辦人 John Collison 的 Podcast 節目《Cheeky Pint》訪問，談及 Muse Wonder 的研發歷程，以及 Meta 如何在龐大資金壓力下，推進前沿模型與個人超級智慧布局。
模型尚未驗證 祖克柏先押千億美元
亞歷山大王回憶，去年底 Meta 核心主管前往夏威夷參加年度高階主管團隊活動時，蘇珊李曾私下將他拉到一旁，嚴肅且反覆提醒：「如果這個前沿 AI 模型研發失敗了，從財務角度來看，後果將非常、非常嚴重。」
這番警告背後，是 Meta 已決定承擔的龐大基礎設施支出。當時 Muse Wonder 及整體前沿模型架構仍處於早期階段，連核心技術驗證都尚未完成，但面對 OpenAI 與 Google 加速推進 AI，祖克柏已決定擴大投入。
在拍板之前，祖克柏直接詢問亞歷山大王，是否確定這項計畫能夠成功。獲得肯定答覆後，他便決定投入 1000 億至 2000 億美元，用於 GPU、資料中心、冷卻設備及電力等基礎設施。
這也意味著，Meta 必須在模型能力尚未獲得充分驗證時，先承擔大規模投資的風險。亞歷山大王與研發團隊接下來數月的任務，就是讓模型成果足以支撐這筆投入。
測試成績亮眼 實際表現仍受質疑
Muse Wonder 隨後交出具競爭力的測試成績。完整版 Wonder Full 在綜合智慧評測中取得 56 分，超越 Fable 5.1，僅次於 Opus 5.5；在長時間軟體工程任務方面，DeepSWE 測試通過率約達 79%。
這些成績也讓 Meta 從開源 Llama 的布局，進一步跨入頂級閉源 AI 智慧體（Agent）的競爭，尤其將焦點放在需要持續執行的軟體工程任務。
不過，亮眼的測試數據並未平息外界對實際使用體驗的疑慮。Muse Wonder 發布後，部分使用者批評，模型可能過度針對基準測試最佳化，實際表現卻未必與分數相符。
例如，在生成熔岩燈的測試中，模型未能呈現燈具、玻璃與熔岩效果，反而做出紅色圓柱體。網路使用者 Token Gremlin 也批評，Muse Wonder 撰寫 Three.js 程式的表現不佳，連製作簡單的《Minecraft》仿作都令人失望。
這些回饋使 Muse Wonder 的競爭力出現兩種評價：一方面，長時間編碼任務的測試成績受到關注；另一方面，視覺化程式與展示效果仍面臨質疑。
亞歷山大王回應爭議 強調真實任務用途
面對批評，亞歷山大王在 X 發文表示，團隊開發 Muse Wonder 的目標，是打造能在真實世界中，協助真實使用者完成實際任務的模型。
他指出，研發重點放在社群平台上看起來未必亮眼的能力，而非花俏的 3D 遊戲展示。這番回應凸顯 Meta 對模型用途的定位，但實際使用體驗與測試成績之間的落差，仍是外界討論焦點。
除了能力表現，定價與版本差異也引發開發者質疑。目前開放 API 呼叫的 Muse Wonder 版本，評測得分為 52 分，低於完整版 Wonder Full 的 56 分。
然而，有開發者指出，API 版本每百萬 token 的輸入與輸出價格分別為 4 美元及 20 美元，與評測得分 58 分的 Opus 5.5 相同。完整版 Wonder Full 則僅向訂閱用戶開放，使不同版本的能力與價格差異成為另一項爭議。
長期記憶與任務應變成重點
在訪談中，祖克柏與亞歷山大王也介紹 Muse Wonder 的兩項核心功能：Active Memory 與 Active Focus，分別著重長期記憶及任務執行時的應變能力。
Active Memory 旨在讓模型記住跨越數天、數週，甚至數月的重要資訊。Meta 表示，團隊投入大量心力，讓模型能保留對使用者重要的事情，使互動不再侷限於單次對話。
當模型參與電子郵件、行程安排與個人文件等工作時，這項能力有助於延續使用者的偏好與需求，也成為部分開發者認為比單一評測分數更值得關注的方向。
Active Focus 則著重模型遇到困難時，能否持續推進任務。團隊透過大量真實世界的失敗情境進行訓練，讓模型在執行受阻時主動尋找替代方案，並在進行關鍵操作前，停下來向使用者確認。
在展示中，Muse Wonder 能持續搜尋租屋資訊，依照個人條件篩選，甚至自主聯絡房東，呈現 Meta 希望發展的個人助理用途。
祖克柏看好個人超級智慧
至於為何願意投入如此龐大的資金，祖克柏在訪談中表示，他不認為 AI 市場最終會走向贏家通吃，也不相信所有需求都將由單一大模型壟斷。
相較之下，他看好由眾多個人超級智慧組成的未來。這項判斷也呼應 Meta 成立超級智慧實驗室，以及推動智慧體商業、發展超越智慧型手機硬體的方向。
在這項構想下，具備長期記憶能力的模型可與智慧眼鏡等裝置結合，使用者的個人智慧體則能與商家的智慧體溝通、出價及購買商品，將 AI 從對話工具延伸至日常生活與商業活動。
Muse Wonder 的測試成績，為 Meta 的頂尖模型布局提供了初步成果，但實際體驗、版本差異與定價仍有待使用者檢驗。對已承擔千億美元投資的 Meta 而言，如何讓模型在真實任務中持續展現價值，正是這場 AI 豪賭的核心考驗。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) AI leader Alexandr Wang recently disclosed that before the top AI model had completed technical validation, CEO Mark Zuckerberg approved an investment of $100 billion to $200 billion to build infrastructure. This gamble prompted CFO Susan Li to solemnly warn that if the model development fails, the company could face extremely serious financial consequences.

Alexandr Wang and Mark Zuckerberg recently appeared together on Stripe co‑founder John Collison’s podcast “Cheeky Pint,” discussing the development of Muse Wonder and how Meta is pushing frontier models and personal super‑intelligence initiatives under massive funding pressure.
Zuckerberg bets billions before the model is validated

Wang recalled that at the end of last year, when Meta’s senior executives were in Hawaii for the annual senior‑leadership retreat, Susan Li pulled him aside privately and repeatedly warned, “If this frontier AI model development fails, the financial fallout will be very, very severe.”

Behind that warning is the massive infrastructure spend Meta has already committed to. At the time, Muse Wonder and the broader frontier‑model architecture were still in early stages, with core technology validation not yet completed, but faced with OpenAI and Google accelerating their AI efforts, Zuckerberg decided to increase spending.

Before signing off, Zuckerberg directly asked Wang whether he was confident the project could succeed. After receiving a positive answer, he decided to invest $100 billion to $200 billion for GPUs, data centers, cooling equipment and power infrastructure.

This means Meta must shoulder the risk of a large‑scale investment before the model’s capabilities are fully validated. Wang and his R&D team’s task over the next few months is to deliver model results that justify that outlay.
Impressive test scores but real‑world performance still questioned

Muse Wonder subsequently delivered competitive test results. The full‑version Wonder Full scored 56 in a comprehensive intelligence benchmark, beating Fable 5.1 and trailing only Opus 5.5; in long‑duration software‑engineering tasks, the DeepSWE pass rate was about 79%.
These results also moved Meta from its open‑source Llama strategy into the top tier of closed‑source AI agents, especially focusing on software‑engineering tasks that require sustained execution.

However, the strong test numbers have not quelled external doubts about actual user experience. After Muse Wonder’s release, some users criticized that the model may be over‑optimized for benchmark tests, with real‑world performance not necessarily matching the scores.

For example, in a lava‑lamp generation test the model failed to render the lamp, glass and lava effect, instead producing a red cylinder. Online user Token Gremlin also complained that Muse Wonder’s Three.js code generation was poor, even struggling to produce a simple Minecraft‑style clone.

These feedbacks created two contrasting assessments of Muse Wonder’s competitiveness: on one hand, the long‑duration coding task scores draw attention; on the other, its visual‑programming and rendering capabilities remain in doubt.
Wang responds to controversy, emphasizing real‑world task utility
Facing criticism, Wang posted on X that the team’s goal in developing Muse Wonder is to build a model that helps real users complete real tasks in the real world.

He noted that the R&D focus is on capabilities that may not look flashy on a social platform, rather than showy 3D‑game demos. This response highlights Meta’s positioning of the model’s use case, but the gap between test scores and actual experience remains a focal point of discussion.
Beyond performance, pricing and version differences have also sparked developer concerns. The currently open API version of Muse Wonder scores 52, lower than the full‑version Wonder Full’s 56.

Yet some developers point out that the API version costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, the same pricing as Opus 5.5, which scored 58. The full‑version Wonder Full is only available to subscribers, making capability and price gaps another point of contention.
Long‑term memory and task adaptability become focal points
In the interview, Zuckerberg and Wang also introduced two core features of Muse Wonder: Active Memory and Active Focus, which focus respectively on long‑term memory and adaptive task execution.

Active Memory is designed to let the model retain important information across days, weeks, or even months. Meta says the team has poured effort into enabling the model to remember user‑important details so interactions are no longer limited to a single conversation.
When the model handles email, scheduling or personal documents, this ability helps maintain user preferences and needs, and some developers view it as more noteworthy than a single benchmark score.

Active Focus concentrates on whether the model can keep pushing a task forward when it encounters difficulty. The team trained the model on many real‑world failure scenarios so that when execution stalls it proactively seeks alternatives and pauses to confirm with the user before critical actions.

In demos, Muse Wonder continuously searches rental listings, filters them according to personal criteria, and even contacts landlords autonomously, showcasing Meta’s vision for a personal‑assistant use case.
Zuckerberg bullish on personal super‑intelligence

When asked why he is willing to commit such massive funding, Zuckerberg said he does not believe the AI market will end up with a single winner monopolizing everything, nor that all demand will be satisfied by one giant model.

Instead, he is optimistic about a future composed of many personal super‑intelligences. This view aligns with Meta’s creation of a Super‑Intelligence Lab and its push toward commercial agents and hardware that goes beyond smartphones.

Under this vision, models with long‑term memory can pair with smart‑glasses and other devices, allowing a user’s personal AI to communicate, negotiate and purchase from merchant AIs, extending AI from a conversational tool to everyday life and commerce.

Muse Wonder’s test results give Meta an early foothold in its top‑model strategy, but real‑world experience, version differences and pricing still need user validation. For Meta, which has already committed a $100 billion‑plus investment, proving the model can continuously deliver value in real tasks is the core test of this AI gamble.

items.title: Anthropic傳將公佈Q3財務數據！2兆美元IPO估值能否實現？
items.title_en: Anthropic Said to Release Q3 Financials! Can a $2 Trillion IPO Valuation Be Achieved?
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創巨頭 Anthropic 傳將於週三（14日）首度向潛在投資人揭露第三季財務數據，為可能成為史上最大規模的首次公開發行（IPO）預作準備。
根據《CNBC》報導，兩名知情人士透露，總部位於舊金山的 Anthropic 計畫在一場投資人會議中，向一群機構投資人公布第三季財務數據。
此次財報揭露正值市場高度關注AI企業的營收表現之際。近期，未上市AI巨頭的財務數據及會計認列方式，已對整體金融市場產生顯著影響。
上週，一份涉及OpenAI營收及會計處理方式的報導引發市場混淆，拖累多家主要半導體股及那斯達克指數走低。
OpenAI在進行新一輪募資期間，向現有投資人提供更新後的營收數字，金額為500億美元，低於市場先前廣泛流傳的700億美元。
不過，知情人士指出，兩個數字的差異主要來自更新後的統計方式排除了雲端合作夥伴的營收，並不代表市場需求出現變化。
目前尚不清楚 Anthropic 是否採用相同的營收認列方式，或是否將合作夥伴相關收入納入統計。不過，此次公布的財務數據預料將有助投資人更準確掌握公司的成長與獲利狀況，進一步評估上市估值，也讓Anthropic高層及承銷銀行得以觀察投資人對最新財務表現的反應。
據知情人士透露，Anthropic正持續推進上市規劃，若以最新公布的營收數據為基礎，公司估值可能達到2兆美元。相關人士並指出，Anthropic營收有望在今年底突破1,000億美元。
若Anthropic以此估值上市，將超越SpaceX(SPCX-US) 此前備受矚目的歷史性上市規模。
Anthropic今年稍早已向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）秘密提交上市申請，但尚未公開S-1註冊文件中的財務資訊。《路透》先前報導，公司可能於11月上市，不過，知情人士尚無法確認確切日期。
除了公司自身的財務表現，外部市場環境也為IPO增添變數。隨著利率攀升，AI產業的融資條件及投資人風險偏好正受到考驗。
博通(AVGO-US) 執行長陳福陽（Hock Tan）本週一（12日）在一場會議上表示，隨著利率上升，取得資金可能成為AI企業面臨的最大限制之一。
週二，半導體類股持續下跌，延續隔夜的賣壓。這波賣壓源於市場對AI產業融資能否持續的擔憂。
《CNBC》指出，市場環境是 Anthropic 即將進行的IPO面臨的最大影響因素之一，承銷銀行正密切關注投資人對高成長股票及AI類股的投資意願。
paras_en: AI startup giant Anthropic is said to disclose its third‑quarter financials to potential investors on Wednesday (the 14th), preparing for what could become the largest IPO ever.
According to CNBC, two insiders said San Francisco‑based Anthropic plans to present its Q3 numbers to a group of institutional investors at an investor meeting.

The earnings release comes as the market closely watches AI companies' revenue performance, with recent financial data and accounting methods of private AI giants already having a noticeable impact on the broader financial markets.
Last week a report on OpenAI’s revenue and accounting practices sparked market confusion, pulling down several major semiconductor stocks and the Nasdaq index.
During a new fundraising round, OpenAI gave existing investors an updated revenue figure of $50 billion, lower than the previously widely circulated $70 billion estimate.
However, insiders noted the discrepancy stems from the updated methodology, which excludes cloud‑partner revenue, and does not indicate a change in market demand.

It remains unclear whether Anthropic will use the same revenue recognition approach or include partner‑related income, but the forthcoming data is expected to help investors better gauge the company’s growth and profitability, assess a potential listing valuation, and let Anthropic’s executives and underwriters gauge investor reaction to the latest performance.
Sources say Anthropic is pushing ahead with its IPO plan and, based on the newly disclosed revenue, could be valued at up to $2 trillion, with revenue projected to exceed $100 billion by year‑end.
If listed at that valuation, Anthropic would surpass SpaceX (SPCX‑US), which has been noted for its historic IPO size.

Anthropic filed a confidential registration statement with the SEC earlier this year but has not yet made the S‑1 financials public; Reuters previously reported a possible November listing, though insiders cannot confirm a specific date.
Beyond the company’s own results, external market conditions add uncertainty to the IPO, as rising interest rates test financing conditions and investor risk appetite in the AI sector.
Broadcom (AVGO‑US) CEO Hock Tan said on Monday (the 12th) that higher rates could make capital access the biggest constraint for AI firms.
On Tuesday semiconductor stocks kept falling, extending the overnight sell‑off driven by worries over whether AI financing can be sustained.
CNBC noted that market conditions are one of the biggest factors affecting Anthropic’s upcoming IPO, with underwriters closely monitoring investor appetite for high‑growth and AI‑related stocks.

items.title: Meta受Muse帶動後仍有35%上漲空間？分析師揭關鍵
items.title_en: Does Meta Still Have 35% Upside After Muse? Analysts Reveal Key Factors
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，Meta Platforms(META-US)股價在AI代理工具 Muse引發市場熱潮後，近期漲勢暫歇。但Truist Securities分析師認為，這家社群媒體公司只是在蓄積動能，準備迎接下一波漲勢。
Meta週二(13日)上漲2.6%，收在762.50美元。自8月股價跌至約550美元低點以來已大幅反彈。9月推出Muse後，市場對執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)的AI策略重新恢復信心。
Truist分析師Youssef Squali認為，Meta後市仍有上漲空間。他在週二發布的研究報告中，將Meta目標價從763美元調高至1,000美元。以週一收盤價計算，這代表股價還有約35%上漲空間。此目標價是以2027年預估獲利的31.8倍本益比，或企業價值相當於營收8.3倍為基礎。
Squali寫道，「我們對Meta財報前景仍持正面看法，預期業績將落在公司財測及市場共識預期的高端，主要受惠於變現能力提升及強勁的用戶參與度。」
「隨著AI全面提升廣告、穿戴式裝置及Muse的表現，包括透過個人超級智慧服務，以及面向企業與中小型企業的Muse產品創造非廣告營收，我們認為Meta長期將是AI領域的贏家。」
Meta今年7月公布的上一季財報，受到支出攀升及一筆與潛在法律成本有關的巨額費用影響，市場焦點因此被轉移。Meta可能仍須面對社群媒體有害影響所引發的監管和解風險，但未來Muse的商業化變現，將有望成為正面動能。
Truist分析師預估，到2030年，Muse可望為Meta額外創造285億美元營收，其中包括訂閱收入，以及用戶透過該AI代理進行商業交易所帶來的相關收入。
然而，AI仍是一門「付費參與」的生意。投資人必須接受Meta進一步增加資本支出。Squali預估，Meta 2027年全年資本支出將達1,900億美元，較前一年增加32%。
Squali寫道，「考量到營收成長可能落在市場預期的高端，而且Muse已開始顯現初步成效，包括用戶成長與參與度提升，我們認為Meta將再次表明，公司打算繼續大舉投資基礎設施建置。」
看好Meta的不只Truist。華爾街也對Meta週一推出的新AI模型Wonder給予正面評價。Meta表示，Wonder在公開基準測試中的表現可與OpenAI及Anthropic頂尖模型匹敵，而且很快就會應用於Muse。
法國巴黎銀行資深股票分析師Nick Jones 在週二的研究報告中寫道，「Meta產品推出速度之快，令我們感到振奮，且公司也有望在核心廣告業務之外，開闢新的AI投資變現管道。」
Jones表示，「接下來，我們將關注第三季財報電話會議，了解產品初期的採用情況，並觀察第三方數據，以判斷這些新模型是否已提升用戶對Meta Muse的參與度與使用率。」
Jones給予Meta股票885美元的目標價。
只要市場願意接受龐大投資所帶來的成本，Meta股價看來仍有進一步上漲空間。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Meta Platforms (META-US) stock, after a market frenzy sparked by the AI agent tool Muse, has recently paused its rally. However, Truist Securities analysts believe the social media company is merely building momentum, preparing for the next wave of gains.

Meta rose 2.6% on Tuesday (the 13th), closing at $762.50. Since its dip to about $550 in August, the stock has rebounded sharply. After Muse launched in September, the market regained confidence in CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s AI strategy.

Truist analyst Youssef Squali sees further upside for Meta. In a research note released on Tuesday, he raised Meta’s target price from $763 to $1,000, which, based on Monday’s close, implies roughly a 35% upside. The target is based on a 31.8‑times 2027 earnings multiple or an enterprise value equal to 8.3 times revenue.

Squali wrote, “We remain positive on Meta’s financial outlook, expecting results to land at the high end of the company’s guidance and market consensus, driven primarily by improved monetization and strong user engagement.”

“As AI lifts advertising, wearables and Muse performance—including personal super‑intelligence services and Muse products for enterprises and SMBs that generate non‑ad revenue—we believe Meta will be a long‑term winner in the AI space.”

Meta’s Q3 earnings released in July were clouded by rising expenses and a large charge related to potential legal costs, shifting market focus. While Meta may still face regulatory and settlement risks from the harmful impacts of social media, the future commercialization of Muse is expected to provide positive momentum.

Truist estimates that by 2030 Muse could generate an additional $28.5 billion in revenue for Meta, including subscription fees and revenue from user‑driven commercial transactions through the AI agent.

However, AI remains a “pay‑to‑participate” business. Investors must accept Meta’s further capital‑expenditure increases. Squali projects Meta’s full‑year 2027 capex at $190 billion, 32% higher than the prior year.

Squali added, “Given revenue growth could sit at the high end of market expectations and Muse is already showing early traction with user growth and engagement, we believe Meta will again signal its intent to continue large‑scale infrastructure investment.”

Meta’s prospects are not only favored by Truist. Wall Street also gave a positive nod to Meta’s new AI model Wonder, launched on Monday. Meta says Wonder’s performance on public benchmarks rivals top models from OpenAI and Anthropic and will soon be integrated into Muse.

BNP Paribas senior equity analyst Nick Jones wrote in a Tuesday research note, “The speed at which Meta rolls out products is exciting, and the company is poised to open new AI monetization pathways beyond its core advertising business.”

Jones added, “Going forward, we’ll watch the Q3 earnings call to gauge early product adoption and monitor third‑party data to assess whether these new models have boosted user engagement and usage of Meta Muse.”
Jones assigns Meta a target price of $885 per share.
As long as the market is willing to absorb the costs of massive investment, Meta’s stock appears to have further upside.

items.title: 博通CEO一句話掀波瀾！「AI投資人像賭徒」惹議 市場多空解讀戰開打
items.title_en: Broadcom CEO’s Remark Sparks Controversy: “AI Investors Are Like Gamblers” Fuels Market Debate
paras: 博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)執行長陳福陽(Hock Tan)在新加坡一場會議上的發言，成為晶片股周一與周二(13日)下跌的原因之一。《MarketWatch》報導，雖然市場聚焦他將人工智慧(AI)投資人比喻為賭場賭徒的言論，但這番話是否代表他看淡AI前景，也引發不同解讀。
根據《彭博》的報導，陳福陽在星展銀行(DBS)舉辦的「亞洲未來前瞻」會議上表示，AI投資人就像賭場賭徒。
不過，其他媒體對這番發言有不同詮釋。例如《香港經濟日報》報導指出，陳福陽所指的是，投資人若根據短期數據賣出股票，例如上周引發市場波動的OpenAI年化營收數據，就像賭場賭徒。
從更廣泛的脈絡來看，陳福陽與同場與談的英特爾(INTC-US)執行長陳立武(Lip-Bu Tan)想傳達的重點，是市場需求依然極為強勁。《MarketWatch》已聯繫博通與星展銀行，希望取得會議的實際錄音或逐字稿。

高盛：言論遭斷章取義 AI需求仍強勁

iShares半導體ETF(SOXX-US)周一下跌3%，周二再跌0.2%。博通股價周一下跌2%，周二則反彈0.7%。
高盛歐洲One Delta交易部主管Rich Privorotsky說：「陳福陽將AI投資人比喻為賭徒的言論，遭到嚴重斷章取義。博通與英特爾都再次確認，未來兩到三年、甚至可能一路延續至2030年的需求，都異常強勁。」
不過，《Wolf Street》部落格作者Wolf Richter認為，「賭徒」這番話確實點出一項核心問題：儘管AI實驗室投入巨額資金，其商業模式仍不明朗；企業究竟如何從AI獲利，也仍存在不確定性。
他進一步指出，AI投資的報酬率尚未明朗，而「如何為這一切提供資金，是最大的限制因素」。
投資人很快就能取得更多實際數據，為這場爭論提供依據。半導體設備製造商艾司摩爾(ASML-US)將於周三公布財報，晶圓代工龍頭廠台積電(TSM-US)也將於周四公布業績，兩家公司的最新財報與展望，將有助於市場評估半導體需求的強度，以及AI投資熱潮能否持續。
paras_en: Broadcom (AVGO-US) CEO Hock Tan’s remarks at a conference in Singapore became one of the reasons chip stocks fell on Monday and Tuesday (the 13th). MarketWatch reported that while the market focused on his comparison of AI investors to casino gamblers, it was unclear whether the comment signaled a bearish view on AI, prompting divergent interpretations.
According to Bloomberg, Tan said at DBS Bank’s “Asia Future Outlook” conference that AI investors are like casino gamblers.

However, other outlets offered different readings. The Hong Kong Economic Times noted that Tan was referring to investors who sell stocks based on short‑term data—such as last week’s OpenAI annual‑revenue figures that rattled markets—much like gamblers in a casino.

In a broader context, Tan and Intel (INTC-US) CEO Lip‑Bu Tan, who spoke at the same event, were trying to convey that market demand remains extremely strong. MarketWatch has reached out to Broadcom and DBS for an audio recording or transcript of the session.

Goldman Sachs: Remarks Taken Out of Context, AI Demand Still Strong
iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX-US) fell 3% on Monday and another 0.2% on Tuesday. Broadcom’s share price dropped 2% on Monday and rebounded 0.7% on Tuesday.

Rich Privorotsky, head of Goldman Sachs Europe’s One Delta trading desk, said Tan’s comparison of AI investors to gamblers was severely taken out of context. Both Broadcom and Intel reaffirmed that demand over the next two‑to‑three years—and possibly through 2030—remains unusually robust.

Nevertheless, Wolf Richter, a Wolf Street blogger, argued that the “gambler” comment does highlight a core issue: despite massive spending by AI labs, their business models are still unclear, and it remains uncertain how companies will profit from AI.
He added that the return on AI investment is still undefined, and “how to fund all of this is the biggest limiting factor.”

Investors will soon have more concrete data to inform the debate. Semiconductor equipment maker ASML (ASML-US) will release earnings on Wednesday, and wafer‑fab leader TSMC (TSM-US) will report results on Thursday. The latest results and outlooks from the two firms will help the market gauge the strength of semiconductor demand and whether the AI investment frenzy can be sustained.

items.title: 簡直是災難！英特爾前高管再轟HBM：位元密度低的「熱三明治」
items.title_en: A Complete Disaster! Former Intel Executive Slams HBM Again: Low Bit Density ‘Thermal Sandwich’
paras: 英特爾前執行長季辛格最新專訪再轟高頻寬記憶體(HBM)，直稱其「醜陋、太差勁」，雖是現階段最佳方案，卻有嚴重架構缺陷。
他指出，HBM位元密度低，且受「海岸線頻寬」限制。透過超寬匯流排連接運算晶片，HBM3/3E為1024位、HBM4升至2048位，物理層佔用晶片邊緣大量矽面積，運算晶片通常僅兩邊放HBM、另兩邊給系統I/O，可堆疊數量受限。
散熱是另一痛點。季辛格曾在RAISE峰會警告垂直堆疊形成「熱三明治」。根據韓國科學技術院分析，HBM功耗超過約30瓦後，物理層自身發熱即成記憶體熱應力主源，而DRAM不耐高溫，資料過度集中更不利AI推理與訓練。
供應面同樣承壓。HBM製程複雜，生產同等容量約耗用普通DRAM三倍晶圓，龍頭與代工廠擴產排擠DDR、LPDDR等通用材料。
台灣南亞科技預期DRAM供不應求可能延續至2028年初；SK海力士副總裁金浩植亦公開表示，HBM並非解決「記憶體牆」的最終答案，公司正研究新架構。
不過，隨著AI參數與上下文變長，業界加快探索運算近記憶體、光互連與新材質。季辛格坦言短期仍離不開HBM，但長線必須有替代方案，否則AI擴張將持續受記憶體頻寬、功耗與成本三面夾擊。
paras_en: In a recent interview, former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger once again blasted high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), calling it "ugly and terrible". While it may be the best solution available today, it suffers from serious architectural flaws.

He pointed out that HBM has low bit density and is constrained by "coastline bandwidth". Connected to compute chips via ultra‑wide buses, HBM3/3E uses a 1024‑bit interface and HBM4 jumps to 2048 bits, occupying a large amount of silicon area along the chip edge. Typically, compute chips place HBM on only two sides, leaving the other two sides for system I/O, which limits how many stacks can be stacked.

Thermal issues are another pain point. Gelsinger warned at the RAISE summit that vertical stacking creates a "thermal sandwich". According to analysis by Korea’s Institute of Science and Technology, once HBM power consumption exceeds roughly 30 W, the physical layer itself generates heat that becomes the main source of memory thermal stress, and DRAM cannot tolerate high temperatures; excessive data concentration further harms AI inference and training.

Supply constraints are also pressing. HBM’s manufacturing process is complex, and producing the same capacity consumes about three times as many wafers as ordinary DRAM. Leading vendors and foundries expanding HBM production are crowding out DDR, LPDDR and other general‑purpose memory materials.

Taiwan’s Nanya Technology expects DRAM shortages to persist into early 2028; SK Hynix vice‑president Kim Ho‑sik also publicly stated that HBM is not the ultimate answer to the "memory wall" and the company is researching new architectures.

However, as AI models grow larger and context lengths increase, the industry is accelerating exploration of near‑memory computing, photonic interconnects and new materials. Gelsinger admits that HBM will still be needed in the short term, but a long‑term alternative is essential, otherwise AI expansion will continue to be squeezed by memory bandwidth, power and cost constraints.

items.title: 特斯拉無人計程車涉學區超速遭美國監管機關審查 估涉及1000輛車
items.title_en: Tesla Autonomous Taxi Faces Speeding Allegations in School Zones, Under U.S. Regulatory Review, Potentially Involving 1,000 Vehicles
paras: 美國國家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 正評估是否針對特斯拉 (Tesla) (TSLA-US) 無人計程車涉嫌在學校區域超速一事展開正式調查。
監管機關收到的請願指出，特斯拉2026年式Model Y及Cybercab在自動駕駛系統啟動期間，疑似未遵守學校區域的速限規定。NHTSA估計，相關審查可能涉及約1,000輛車，案件目前仍處於請願評估階段，尚未正式決定是否啟動完整的缺陷調查。
NHTSA缺陷調查辦公室 (ODI) 於9月23日收到調查請願，並在10月9日建立案件檔案，編號為DP26010。請願人提供3段社群媒體影片作為佐證，監管機關的紀錄則列出4起相關事件。目前尚未通報任何與這些事件相關的碰撞、受傷或死亡事故。
依照美國聯邦法規49 CFR Part 552，NHTSA須在收到請願後120天內決定是否接受或駁回，因此預計最遲約於2027年1月21日作出決定。若接受請願，將進一步展開正式缺陷調查，後續可能導致召回，但目前尚未進入這一階段。
這次審查也讓外界首次從聯邦監管機關取得特斯拉無人計程車車隊規模的估計數字。特斯拉並未公開完整車隊數量，NHTSA目前估計約有1,000輛相關車輛。這項數字不代表所有車輛都已投入營運，也不等於目前實際上路的無人計程車數量。此前，社群追蹤者在今年6月估計，奧斯汀、達拉斯及休士頓等地實際運行的車輛僅有數十輛。
特斯拉在德州奧斯汀的無人計程車服務於2025年6月開始有限度推出，初期仍有車內人員。公司之後進一步導入Cybercab，並於2026年9月3日在奧斯汀啟動商業服務。Cybercab採用無方向盤、無煞車踏板及無側後視鏡的設計，相關車輛與自動駕駛技術也持續受到監管機關檢視。
超速爭議並非特斯拉自動駕駛系統首次遭到質疑。2025年6月，特斯拉在奧斯汀推出無人計程車服務期間，就曾有影片顯示車輛疑似超速，當時NHTSA表示正與特斯拉聯繫了解情況。同年10月，NHTSA另行調查特斯拉的Full Self-Driving (FSD) 系統是否涉及違反交通規則，包括闖紅燈及駛入錯誤車道等情況。
此次事件的關鍵在於責任歸屬與駕駛模式的差異。使用FSD輔助駕駛功能時，車內仍有駕駛人負責監督並承擔駕駛責任；無人計程車在自動駕駛系統運作時，則可能沒有駕駛人坐在方向盤後方。因此，若系統確實在學校區域超速，監管機關將需要釐清自動駕駛系統如何判斷車速，以及相關設計與運作是否符合交通安全要求。
除了超速請願，Cybercab的車輛認證程序也面臨另一項監管審查。NHTSA先前要求特斯拉提供宣誓資料，說明沒有方向盤及踏板的Cybercab如何符合聯邦汽車安全標準，相關答覆期限為9月30日，但監管機關尚未公開特斯拉提交的內容。這意味著特斯拉的無人計程車車隊在道路安全及車輛合規性方面，同時面臨多項審查。
其他自動駕駛業者也曾遭遇類似問題。Alphabet旗下自動駕駛公司Waymo，先前因車輛在德州奧斯汀被指約20次違規超越停靠中的校車而受到關注，並於2025年12月提出自願軟體召回，以處理相關問題。此外，Waymo一輛自動駕駛車今年1月在加州聖塔莫尼卡一所小學附近撞上一名兒童，造成輕傷。Waymo表示，事故後兒童自行走到人行道，公司並撥打911。
隨著特斯拉擴大無人計程車服務，監管機關如何評估自動駕駛系統在學校周邊等高風險環境中的速度控制、交通規則遵循及車輛安全責任，將成為後續調查的重要焦點。這次請願是否進一步升級為正式缺陷調查，仍須等待NHTSA決定；截至相關報導刊出時，特斯拉尚未就這次超速指控作出公開回應。
paras_en: The U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) is evaluating whether to launch a formal investigation into Tesla (TSLA-US) autonomous taxis alleged to have exceeded speed limits in school zones.

The petition received by the regulator alleges that Tesla’s 2026‑model Model Y and Cybercab may have failed to obey school‑zone speed limits while the autonomous driving system was engaged. NHTSA estimates the review could involve roughly 1,000 vehicles; the case remains at the petition‑evaluation stage and no decision has been made to open a full defect investigation.

NHTSA’s Office of Defects Investigation (ODI) received the petition on September 23 and opened a case file on October 9, assigned DP26010. The petitioner supplied three social‑media video clips as evidence, and the agency’s records list four related incidents. No collisions, injuries, or fatalities linked to these events have been reported yet.

Under U.S. federal regulation 49 CFR Part 552, NHTSA must decide within 120 days whether to accept or reject the petition, so a decision is expected by about January 21, 2027 at the latest. If the petition is accepted, a formal defect investigation would commence, potentially leading to a recall, though that stage has not been reached.

This review also provides the first estimate from a federal regulator of the size of Tesla’s autonomous‑taxi fleet. Tesla has not disclosed the total fleet size; NHTSA currently estimates about 1,000 relevant vehicles. The figure does not imply all are in operation, nor does it equal the number of autonomous taxis actually on the road. Earlier, social‑media followers estimated in June that only a few dozen vehicles were operating in Austin, Dallas and Houston.

Tesla’s autonomous‑taxi service in Austin, Texas began a limited rollout in June 2025 with a driver on board. The company later introduced the Cybercab and launched commercial service in Austin on September 3, 2026. The Cybercab features a design without a steering wheel, brake pedal or side mirrors, and the vehicles and their autonomous technology continue to be scrutinized by regulators.

The speeding controversy is not the first time Tesla’s autonomous driving system has been questioned. In June 2025, during the Austin autonomous‑taxi rollout, video surfaced suggesting a vehicle was speeding, prompting NHTSA to contact Tesla for clarification. In October of the same year, NHTSA opened a separate probe into Tesla’s Full Self‑Driving (FSD) system for possible traffic‑law violations such as running red lights and driving in the wrong lane.

The crux of this incident lies in liability and the difference in driving modes. When FSD is used with a driver present, the occupant remains responsible for monitoring and bearing driving responsibility; an autonomous taxi operating without a driver behind the wheel may lack a human overseer. If the system indeed exceeded speed limits in school zones, regulators will need to determine how the autonomous system calculates speed and whether its design and operation meet safety requirements.

Beyond the speeding petition, the Cybercab’s vehicle certification process faces another regulatory review. NHTSA previously asked Tesla to submit sworn statements explaining how a Cybercab without a steering wheel or pedals complies with federal motor‑vehicle safety standards, with a response deadline of September 30. The agency has not yet made Tesla’s submission public, indicating the fleet is under multiple safety and compliance examinations.

Other autonomous‑driving companies have encountered similar issues. Alphabet’s Waymo was previously highlighted for about 20 alleged violations of passing a stopped school bus in Austin, Texas, and issued a voluntary software recall in December 2025 to address the problem. Additionally, a Waymo autonomous vehicle struck a child near an elementary school in Santa Monica, California, in January this year, causing minor injuries; Waymo said the child walked onto the sidewalk after the crash and the company called 911.

As Tesla expands its autonomous‑taxi service, how regulators assess speed control, traffic‑rule compliance and vehicle safety responsibility in high‑risk areas such as school zones will be a key focus of ongoing investigations. Whether the petition escalates to a formal defect investigation remains pending NHTSA’s decision; at the time of reporting, Tesla had not issued a public response to the speeding allegations.

items.title: 新加坡Q3經濟成長5.4%超預期 全年展望維持4.5%至5.5%
items.title_en: Singapore Q3 Economic Growth 5.4% Beats Expectations, Full-Year Outlook Remains 4.5% to 5.5%
paras: 新加坡能源、貿易暨工業部(METI)周三(14日)發布最新預估數據顯示，新加坡2026年第三季GDP年增5.4%，優於預期的5.0%。經季節調整後，第三季GDP季增1.1%，稍微低於市場預期的1.2%與上一季的1.5%。
在各產業表現方面，第三季製造業年增7.5%，主要由電子、精密工程、運輸工程與一般製造業群聚支撐，抵銷了化學與生物醫學製造業的衰退，但經季調後製造業季減0.9%。
整體經濟成長延續上半年的強勁趨勢，主要受惠於人工智慧(AI)相關產業與出口表現拉動。政府維持2026全年GDP成長預測於4.5%至5.5%。
此外，新加坡金融管理局(MAS)宣布維持貨幣政策不變，暫停先前因能源價格上漲所採取的緊縮政策。對此，星展銀行(DBS)分析師指出，央行暫緩緊縮主要反映通膨展望較先前預期放緩。
星展銀行分析師預估，新加坡2026年整體CPI平均年增率為2%，核心通膨率放緩至1.5%至2.0%。然而，分析師也提醒，短期內能源價格回升可能帶來通膨壓力，且全球利率若高於預期以及AI投資出現較大幅度拉回，仍是全球與新加坡經濟面臨的主要風險。
金融市場方面，新加坡元兌美元匯率維持在1.26至1.30狹幅震盪，新加坡海峽時報指數上揚0.3%。
paras_en: Singapore's Ministry of Trade and Industry (METI) released its latest estimates on Wednesday (the 14th), showing that Singapore's GDP grew 5.4% year‑on‑year in the third quarter of 2026, ahead of the 5.0% forecast. Seasonally adjusted, the quarter‑on‑quarter GDP increase was 1.1%, slightly below the market expectation of 1.2% and down from 1.5% in the previous quarter.

In terms of sector performance, manufacturing expanded 7.5% year‑on‑year in the third quarter, driven mainly by clusters in electronics, precision engineering, transport engineering and general manufacturing, which offset declines in chemicals and biomedical manufacturing. After seasonal adjustment, manufacturing fell 0.9% quarter‑on‑quarter.

Overall economic growth continued the strong momentum seen in the first half of the year, largely supported by AI‑related industries and export performance. The government kept its full‑year 2026 GDP growth forecast at 4.5%‑5.5%.

In addition, the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) announced that monetary policy would remain unchanged, pausing the tightening measures previously introduced in response to rising energy prices. DBS analysts noted that the central bank’s pause mainly reflects a slower‑than‑expected inflation outlook.

DBS analysts project Singapore's overall CPI to average a 2% year‑on‑year increase in 2026, with core inflation easing to between 1.5% and 2.0%. However, they caution that a short‑term rebound in energy prices could revive inflationary pressure, and that higher‑than‑expected global interest rates and a sharp pull‑back in AI investment remain key risks for both the global and Singapore economies.
In the financial markets, the Singapore dollar held steady against the US dollar in a narrow range of 1.26‑1.30, while the Straits Times Index rose 0.3%.

items.title: 輝達開放Vera Rubin機櫃設計支援250kW液冷架構，攜手科技巨頭推動AI資料中心標準化
items.title_en: Nvidia Opens Vera Rubin Rack Design Supporting 250kW Liquid‑Cooled Architecture, Partners with Tech Giants to Standardize AI Data Centers
paras: 2026年10月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 輝達Nvidia(NVDA-US)於2026年OCP全球高峰會（10月12日至15日）宣布，透過開放式MGX架構，向開放運算計畫（Open Compute Project，OCP）貢獻新一代Vera Rubin機櫃與運算托盤設計，並攜手Google、Meta、微軟及思科等科技業者推動AI資料中心開放標準，降低大型AI運算系統的整合與部署難度。
此次更新的MGX 1.2規範，新增機櫃級盲插式液冷、可互通的機櫃連接介面，以及支援5,000A的液冷電力匯流排，並相容原生19吋設備，最高可支援250kW機櫃功率，協助系統製造商簡化高密度AI機櫃的組裝、測試與維護流程。
除了硬體架構，輝達也開放DSX AI Factory的4項軟體元件，涵蓋交換器設定、GPU叢集壓力測試、機櫃韌體管理及裸機部署。相關技術源自DGX Cloud營運經驗，目標是讓雲端業者能在數小時內將硬體轉換為可正式運作的AI運算叢集。
在產業合作方面，輝達與超微AMD(AMD-US)、Google及Meta共同發布Open Data Center Specification v0.7，統一AI資料中心的電力、散熱及實體配置標準。Google、Meta與微軟Microsoft(MSFT-US)也共同推動電網韌性規範，要求大型AI設施在電網發生擾動時維持連線，並於2秒內恢復至接近滿載的運作狀態。
網路設備方面，Meta將採用輝達Spectrum-6 102.4Tb/s乙太網路交換器建置Vera Rubin AI運算叢集，其交換容量與單通道頻寬均為前代Spectrum-4的2倍，搭配Spectrum-X Multiplane技術，可支援超過10萬顆GPU的大型運算叢集。
此外，輝達與思科Cisco(CSCO-US)共同推出USFP可插拔光模組標準，鎖定新一代高速AI網路架構，透過更高的頻寬密度與能源效率，支援大型GPU叢集的資料傳輸需求。輝達也將與Google合作，讓未來ConnectX-10 SuperNIC及BlueField DPU支援Falcon Transport技術，提高乙太網路AI運算環境的傳輸可靠性與頻寬利用率。

paras_en: October 14, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Nvidia (NVDA-US) announced at the 2026 OCP Global Summit (Oct. 12‑15) that through its open‑source MGX architecture it is contributing a next‑generation Vera Rubin rack and compute tray design to the Open Compute Project (OCP), and is working with Google, Meta, Microsoft and Cisco to promote open standards for AI data centers, reducing the integration and deployment complexity of large‑scale AI systems.

The updated MGX 1.2 specification adds rack‑level blind‑plug liquid cooling, interoperable rack connection interfaces, and a liquid‑cooled power bus supporting 5,000 A, while remaining compatible with native 19‑inch equipment. It can deliver up to 250 kW per rack, helping system manufacturers simplify assembly, testing and maintenance of high‑density AI racks.

Beyond hardware, Nvidia is also open‑sourcing four software components of its DSX AI Factory, covering switch configuration, GPU cluster stress testing, rack firmware management and bare‑metal deployment. The technology draws from DGX Cloud operational experience and aims to let cloud providers turn hardware into production‑ready AI clusters within a few hours.

In industry collaboration, Nvidia, AMD (AMD-US), Google and Meta jointly released Open Data Center Specification v0.7, standardizing power, cooling and physical layout for AI data centers. Google, Meta and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) are also advancing grid‑resilience standards that require large AI facilities to stay connected during grid disturbances and recover to near‑full load within two seconds.

On the networking side, Meta will use Nvidia Spectrum‑6 102.4 Tb/s Ethernet switches to build Vera Rubin AI clusters. The switch capacity and per‑lane bandwidth are twice those of the previous Spectrum‑4, and with Spectrum‑X Multiplane technology it can support clusters of over 100,000 GPUs.

Additionally, Nvidia and Cisco (CSCO‑US) have introduced a USFP pluggable optical module standard targeting next‑generation high‑speed AI network architectures, offering higher bandwidth density and energy efficiency to meet the data‑transfer needs of large GPU clusters. Nvidia will also work with Google to enable future ConnectX‑10 SuperNIC and BlueField DPUs to support Falcon Transport technology, improving transmission reliability and bandwidth utilization in Ethernet AI environments.

items.title: 中國光通訊產業｜華工正源首秀OCP峰會展示3.2T至12.8T光互連方案，6.4T產品功耗降50%
items.title_en: China Optical Communications Industry | Huagong Zhengyuan Debuts at OCP Summit with 3.2T to 12.8T Optical Interconnect Solutions, 6.4T Product Power Consumption Down 50%
paras: 2026年10月14日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 中國光通訊設備商華工科技(000988-CN)旗下華工正源首度參加2026年OCP全球高峰會，展示3.2T高速光模組、6.4T近封裝光學（NPO）及12.8T超高密度可插拔光學（XPO）三大解決方案，布局下一代AI資料中心高速光互連市場。
其中，3.2T光模組採用單波400G技術，搭載3奈米／2奈米製程DSP晶片，單波傳輸速率最高達450Gbps，可相容現有資料中心架構，支援高速網路升級。
6.4T NPO則採用無DSP線性直驅架構，最遠支援500公尺單模光纖傳輸。根據公司公布數據，相較傳統800G OSFP可插拔光模組，其單位面積頻寬密度提升11.4倍，單位位元能耗降低50%，有助於改善AI運算叢集的傳輸效率與功耗。
另一款12.8T XPO採用64通道、單波200G設計，模組功耗低至130W，可使交換器機櫃密度提高4倍。華工正源同時也是XPO MSA標準聯盟創始成員，藉由參與新一代光互連規格制定，擴大在高速光通訊市場的技術布局。
除了光模組，華工正源也持續發展自研矽光晶片、量子點光頻梳外置光源（ELSFP），並建立磷化銦（InP）、砷化鎵（GaAs）及矽光子（SiP）三大光電子製程平台，同時布局薄膜鈮酸鋰技術，強化高速光晶片與光源的自主供應能力。
華工正源是華工科技負責光通訊業務的核心全資子公司，在產業鏈中主要扮演中游光模組與光元件供應商角色，向上布局光晶片自主研發，向下供應雲端服務商、網路設備商及電信業者，具備從光元件、光模組到子系統的垂直整合能力。公司2026年上半年已實現800G、1.6T高速光模組全球規模化交貨，並持續拓展北美雲端客戶。

paras_en: October 14, 2026 (You Analysis / Industry Data Center report) – Huagong Technology (000988-CN) of China, through its wholly‑owned subsidiary Huagong Zhengyuan, participated in the 2026 OCP Global Summit for the first time, showcasing three solutions: a 3.2‑terabit high‑speed optical module, a 6.4‑terabit near‑package optics (NPO) and a 12.8‑terabit ultra‑high‑density pluggable optics (XPO), positioning itself for the next‑generation AI data‑center high‑speed optical interconnect market.

The 3.2‑terabit optical module uses single‑wave 400 Gb/s technology and is equipped with a 3‑nm/2‑nm process DSP chip, achieving a per‑wave transmission rate of up to 450 Gbps. It is compatible with existing data‑center architectures and supports high‑speed network upgrades.

The 6.4‑terabit NPO adopts a DSP‑free linear direct‑drive architecture and can support single‑mode fiber transmission up to 500 meters. According to company data, its bandwidth density per unit area is 11.4 times higher than that of traditional 800 Gb/s OSFP pluggable modules, while its energy consumption per bit is reduced by 50%, helping improve transmission efficiency and power usage in AI compute clusters.

The other offering, a 12.8‑terabit XPO, uses a 64‑channel, single‑wave 200 Gb/s design, with module power consumption as low as 130 W, enabling a four‑fold increase in switch‑rack density. Huagong Zhengyuan is also a founding member of the XPO MSA standards alliance, expanding its technical footprint in the high‑speed optical communications market by participating in the next‑generation interconnect specification development.

Beyond optical modules, Huagong Zhengyuan continues to develop its own silicon photonic chips, quantum‑dot optical frequency comb external light sources (ELSFP), and has built three major optoelectronic process platforms: indium phosphide (InP), gallium arsenide (GaAs) and silicon photonics (SiP). It is also advancing thin‑film lithium niobate technology to strengthen autonomous supply of high‑speed optical chips and light sources.

Huagong Zhengyuan is the core wholly‑owned subsidiary of Huagong Technology responsible for optical communications. In the value chain it mainly acts as a mid‑stream supplier of optical modules and components, while moving upstream into autonomous chip R&D and downstream supplying cloud service providers, network equipment manufacturers and telecom operators, offering vertical integration from components to modules to subsystems. In the first half of 2026 the company achieved global mass production deliveries of 800 Gb/s and 1.6‑terabit high‑speed optical modules and continues to expand its North American cloud customer base.

items.title: 艾司摩爾AI需求旺到2030年！第三季獲利超預期、EUV設備產能吃緊
items.title_en: ASML AI Demand Strong Through 2030! Q3 Profit Beats Expectations, EUV Equipment Capacity Tight
paras: 全球半導體設備龍頭艾司摩爾(ASML-US) 指出，部分客戶已開始表達對2029年、甚至2030年下單採購關鍵半導體設備的興趣，顯示人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮帶動的晶片需求，正進一步延伸至未來數年。艾司摩爾第三季獲利優於市場預期，也為關注其長期成長動能的投資人帶來支撐。
根據《CNBC》報導，艾司摩爾執行長Christophe Fouquet在聲明中表示，客戶持續上修短期與中期設備需求預測，主要受到AI相關投資規模及持續時間預期的影響。
他進一步指出：「考慮到客戶對需求的掌握程度，部分客戶已表達有意向我們下訂2029年、甚至2030年的設備。」
艾司摩爾是全球唯一能生產極紫外光（EUV）微影設備的公司。這類設備是製造最先進半導體的關鍵工具，台積電(2330-TW) 等晶片製造商仰賴相關技術推進先進製程，因此艾司摩爾的財報與訂單展望，一直是投資人觀察AI晶片需求的重要指標。
Fouquet也指出，艾司摩爾目前規劃在2027年與2028年提供的設備產能，仍不足以完全滿足客戶需求。公司正研究擴產方式，希望讓2028年的產能增幅超越先前預估的30%。
本季期間，全球兩大晶片製造商三星電子(005930KS) 與台積電均承諾採用艾司摩爾的高數值孔徑（High NA）極紫外光（EUV）微影設備。
High NA EUV是艾司摩爾的新一代設備，分析師認為，這項技術將是推動該公司未來成長的關鍵。
今年7月，由於設備需求持續強勁，艾司摩爾上修全年銷售額及毛利率預測。該公司股價今年以來已上漲56%。
艾司摩爾週三（14日）縮小全年營收預測區間，並表示目前預估全年淨銷售額將介於440億至450億歐元（493億至504億美元）之間。先前預測區間的下限為430億歐元。
艾司摩爾也預估，第四季淨銷售額將介於142億至152億歐元之間，預測區間上限高於倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）分析師142億歐元的共識預估。
艾司摩爾第三季淨利達49.6億歐元，明顯高於LSEG預期的41億歐元；不過，單季淨銷售額為116.6億歐元，略低於LSEG預估的117.2億歐元。
paras_en: Global semiconductor equipment leader ASML (ASML-US) said that some customers have already begun expressing interest in placing orders for key semiconductor equipment for 2029 and even 2030, indicating that the chip demand driven by the AI investment boom is extending further into the coming years. ASML's third‑quarter profit exceeded market expectations, providing support for investors focused on its long‑term growth momentum.

According to a CNBC report, ASML CEO Christophe Fouquet said in a statement that customers are continuously revising up their short‑ and medium‑term equipment demand forecasts, mainly due to expectations about the scale and duration of AI‑related investments.
He added, "Given the level of insight customers have into demand, some have indicated an intention to place orders with us for equipment in 2029 and even 2030."

ASML is the only company in the world that can produce extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography machines. These tools are critical for manufacturing the most advanced semiconductors, and chipmakers such as TSMC (2330‑TW) rely on the technology to advance their leading‑edge processes, making ASML's earnings and order outlook a key gauge of AI chip demand for investors.

Fouquet also noted that the equipment capacity ASML plans to provide in 2027 and 2028 is still insufficient to fully meet customer demand. The company is studying ways to expand production, aiming for a capacity increase in 2028 that exceeds the previously forecasted 30% growth.
During the quarter, the world’s two largest chip manufacturers, Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and TSMC, both pledged to adopt ASML’s High‑NA (high numerical aperture) EUV lithography equipment.
High‑NA EUV is ASML’s next‑generation system, and analysts believe this technology will be a key driver of the company’s future growth.
In July, due to continued strong equipment demand, ASML raised its full‑year sales and gross‑margin forecasts. The company’s share price has risen 56% so far this year.

On Wednesday (the 14th), ASML narrowed its full‑year revenue guidance, stating that it now expects net sales for the year to be between €44 billion and €45 billion (US$49.3 billion to US$50.4 billion). The lower bound of the previous range was €43 billion.

ASML also projected fourth‑quarter net sales to be between €14.2 billion and €15.2 billion, with the upper end of the range above the consensus estimate of €14.2 billion from London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) analysts.
ASML’s third‑quarter net profit reached €4.96 billion, well above LSEG’s forecast of €4.1 billion; however, quarterly net sales were €11.66 billion, slightly below LSEG’s estimate of €11.72 billion.

items.title: 痛批蓄意推高油價！川普：胡塞武裝這波行動「非常惡劣」 可能要求土耳其加入打擊
items.title_en: Trump Slams Deliberate Oil‑Price Hike! Calls Houthi Action “Extremely Malicious” and May Ask Turkey to Join the Fight
paras: 美國總統川普周二(13日)表示，可能要求土耳其加入沙烏地阿拉伯對葉門胡塞武裝(又譯青年運動)的打擊行動。「我可能會這麼做，我非常尊重土耳其總統艾爾段，相信他會配合。」此言顯示華府與波斯灣盟友正考慮擴大軍事回應，油價與航空風險隨之升溫。
事件起因是上周六(10日)利雅德哈立德國王國際機場航廈遇襲，沙國稱造成12死309傷，川普當日曾稱正評估美國是否加入沙國打擊胡塞，將盡快決定。
川普周二在Truth Social上痛批胡塞以「非常惡劣」手段攻擊沙國，並疑似刻意在美国期中大選前推高油價。
川普出訪阿拉斯加前證實已跟沙國王儲兼首相穆罕默德通話，但拒透露是否已決定參戰，僅稱將就伊朗問題很快作成決定。
近幾日沙國與胡塞持續互攻，沙國主導多國聯軍周一(12日)稱攔截數枚胡塞彈道飛彈；胡塞則指沙國過去24個小時對葉門多地空襲119次，造成民用設施損毀與平民傷亡，多家航空公司因此暫停飛利雅德。
胡塞控制的馬西拉電視台周二報導指出，薩那葉門石油公司設施遭襲，聯軍稍早聲明將打擊該目標。胡塞警告，若薩那設施受擊，將回擊沙國東部達曼沙烏地阿美石油總部、利雅德機場及沙烏地阿美旗下煉油廠。
今年8月，沙國、土耳其與巴基斯坦簽署《麥加共同防務協議》，明定任一方遭武裝攻擊視同對全體攻擊。分析人士指出，若美國正式邀土國參戰，配合該協議與美方增兵評估，衝突可能由葉門、沙國進一步牽動伊朗代理人網絡，全球能源市場波動恐加劇。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday (the 13th) that he may ask Turkey to join Saudi Arabia’s campaign against Yemen’s Houthi rebels (also known as the Youth Movement). “I might do that, I have great respect for Turkish President Erdogan and I believe he will cooperate,” he said, indicating that Washington and its Gulf allies are considering expanding the military response, which could push oil prices and aviation risks higher.

The incident stems from an attack last Saturday (the 10th) on the terminal of King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, which Saudi officials said caused 12 deaths and 309 injuries. Trump said on that day that the United States was evaluating whether to join Saudi strikes against the Houthis and would decide soon.

On Tuesday, Trump used his Truth Social platform to harshly criticize the Houthis for attacking Saudi Arabia with “extremely malicious” tactics and suggested they were deliberately trying to drive up oil prices ahead of the U.S. mid‑term elections.

Before his trip to Alaska, Trump confirmed he had spoken with Saudi Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman but declined to say whether a decision to enter the war had been made, adding only that a decision on Iran would be reached quickly.

In recent days Saudi Arabia and the Houthis have continued to exchange attacks. The Saudi‑led multinational coalition said on Monday (the 12th) it intercepted several Houthi ballistic missiles; the Houthis claimed Saudi airstrikes hit Yemen at 119 locations in the past 24 hours, damaging civilian infrastructure and causing civilian casualties, prompting several airlines to suspend flights to Riyadh.

The Houthi‑controlled Masyra TV reported on Tuesday that facilities of Yemen’s state oil company in Sana’a had been hit, and the coalition earlier announced it would target that site. The Houthis warned that if the Sana’a facilities were struck they would retaliate against Saudi Arabia’s eastern Dammam headquarters of Saudi Aramco, Riyadh airport and Aramco‑owned refineries.

In August this year, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan signed the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement, which treats an armed attack on any signatory as an attack on all. Analysts note that if the United States formally invites Turkey to join the fight, aligning with that pact and U.S. force‑building assessments could expand the conflict from Yemen and Saudi Arabia to Iran’s proxy network, potentially intensifying volatility in global energy markets.

items.title: 馬斯克力挺美光定價合理！記憶體缺貨恐延續至2028年、HBM市場估值看增
items.title_en: Musk Backs Micron's Pricing as Reasonable! Memory Shortage May Persist Until 2028, HBM Market Valuation Expected to Rise
paras: 隨著全球記憶體市場供不應求，記憶體價格與供應商的定價策略成為市場關注焦點。SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克週二（13日）公開肯定美光科技(MU-US) 的未來記憶體定價策略，認為相較於部分收費過高的供應商，美光採取較合理的定價方式，有助於維持長期客戶關係。
根據《Benzinga》報導，馬斯克在社群平台X發文指出，美光對未來記憶體價格的處理方式相當合理，但其他供應商的收費則高得令人難以接受，客戶不會忘記供應商如何對待他們。
他並認為，美光的做法是維持長期客戶忠誠度的明智策略。
這番言論是回應世界貿易證券（World Trade Securities）執行長兼負責人Nicholas Mugalli在X上的貼文。Mugalli當時分享摩根大通一份看好記憶體與儲存市場的研究報告。
Futurum Equities首席市場策略師Shay Boloor則認為，當供應最終逐漸寬鬆時，美光有機會將馬斯克所說的這種「善意」轉化為更長期的合約，以及更高的市場占有率。
摩根大通表示，記憶體市場的基本面「較90天前明顯強勁許多」，目前需求遠高於供給。
該機構預估，2026年記憶體供應短缺幅度約為20%，2027年為19%，2028年則為15%。
高頻寬記憶體（HBM）市場的成長前景同樣受到看好。摩根大通預估，HBM市場規模將從2026年的約640億美元，擴大至2027年的約1,600億美元，並於2028年進一步攀升至2,800億美元。
在供應合約方面，美光的長期客戶協議數量已從16份增加至26份，這些協議涵蓋至2030年、占公司營收逾35%，剩餘履約義務金額達1,500億美元。
此外，美光2027會計年度超過75%的產出已經獲得承諾。
不過，記憶體產業仍面臨競爭與市場情緒帶來的壓力。週二（13日），半導體類股延續跌勢，市場憂慮中國長鑫科技(688825-CN) 在晶片設計方面取得進展，能夠在更小的空間內整合更多記憶體。
相關疑慮已對主要記憶體企業股價造成衝擊。週一（12日），美光市值蒸發約520億美元，SK海力士(000660KS) 市值減少約415億美元，SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 市值則縮水約150億美元。
股價表現方面， 美光週二下跌3.62%，收在953.19美元，盤後上漲0.32%，報956.20美元。
Benzinga Edge的評級數據顯示，美光股票的動能評分位居第99百分位，品質評分則位居第97百分位。
paras_en: As global memory markets face supply shortages, memory prices and suppliers' pricing strategies have become a focal point. SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk on Tuesday (the 13th) publicly affirmed Micron Technology (MU-US)'s future memory pricing strategy, saying that compared with some overly‑priced suppliers, Micron’s more reasonable pricing helps maintain long‑term customer relationships.

According to Benzinga, Musk posted on X that Micron’s handling of future memory prices is quite reasonable, whereas other suppliers charge levels that are hard to accept, and customers will remember how suppliers treat them.
He added that Micron’s approach is a wise strategy for preserving long‑term customer loyalty.
The comments were in response to a post on X by World Trade Securities CEO and principal Nicholas Mugalli, who had shared a JPMorgan research report bullish on the memory and storage market.
Futurum Equities chief market strategist Shay Boloor said that as supply eventually eases, Micron could turn the “goodwill” Musk described into longer‑term contracts and higher market share.
JPMorgan said the fundamentals of the memory market are “significantly stronger than 90 days ago,” with demand now far exceeding supply.
The firm projects memory supply shortages of about 20% in 2026, 19% in 2027 and 15% in 2028.

The high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) market’s growth outlook is also positive. JPMorgan estimates the HBM market will grow from roughly $64 billion in 2026 to about $160 billion in 2027 and further to $280 billion in 2028.

Regarding supply contracts, Micron’s long‑term customer agreements have risen from 16 to 26, covering through 2030 and representing over 35% of revenue, with remaining performance obligations of $150 billion.
In addition, more than 75% of Micron’s output for fiscal year 2027 is already committed.

However, the memory industry still faces pressure from competition and market sentiment. On Tuesday (the 13th), semiconductor stocks continued to fall as the market worried that China’s ChangXin Technology (688825-CN) was making progress in chip design that could integrate more memory in a smaller footprint.

These concerns have already impacted major memory companies’ stock prices. On Monday (the 12th), Micron’s market value shrank by about $52 billion, SK Hynix (000660KS) lost roughly $41.5 billion, and SanDisk (SNDKV-US) shed about $15 billion in market cap.
In terms of stock performance, Micron fell 3.62% on Tuesday, closing at $953.19, and rose 0.32% in after‑hours trading to $956.20.
Benzinga Edge’s rating data shows Micron’s momentum score is in the 99th percentile, while its quality score sits in the 97th percentile.

items.title: 川普宣布格陵蘭將啟動大規模油氣、礦產探勘
items.title_en: Trump Announces Greenland Will Launch Large-Scale Oil, Gas, and Mineral Exploration
paras: 美國總統川普周三(14日)表示，格陵蘭即將展開「大規模」石油、天然氣及礦產探勘。
川普未透露探勘計畫細節，但表示：「有專家指出，當地易於開採的石油蘊藏量，遠高於全球幾乎任何地方。」

美國、丹麥與格陵蘭簽署的協議擴大美軍在格陵蘭的角色，為設立兩座新軍事基地及部署川普的「金穹」飛彈防禦系統鋪路，同時重申丹麥主權與格陵蘭人民的自決權。
paras_en: US President Trump on Wednesday (the 14th) said Greenland is about to commence "large-scale" oil, natural gas and mineral exploration.
Trump did not disclose details of the exploration plan, but said: "Experts point out that the easily extractable oil reserves there are far greater than almost anywhere else in the world."
The United States, Denmark and Greenland signed an agreement last month aimed at easing tensions caused by Trump’s repeated threats to control this strategically located, resource‑rich island.

In a post on Truth Social, Trump also said: "Any future attack against the United States will have to go through Greenland, and our defense system will regularly intercept drones, missiles, and even any new weapons that have not yet been imagined."

The agreement signed by the US, Denmark and Greenland expands the US military role in Greenland, paving the way for two new bases and the deployment of Trump’s "Gold Dome" missile‑defense system, while reaffirming Denmark's sovereignty and the Greenlandic people's right to self‑determination.

items.title: Muse Wonder搞砸會怎樣？Meta財務長私下警告恐釀財務危機
items.title_en: What Happens If Muse Wonder Fails? Meta CFO Quietly Warns of Potential Financial Crisis
paras: Meta(META-US) AI 負責人亞歷山大王（Alexandr Wang）近日透露，在頂尖AI 模型尚未完成技術驗證之際，執行長祖克柏便拍板投入 1000 億至 2000 億美元建置基礎設施。這場豪賭也讓財務長蘇珊李（Susan Li）鄭重警告，若模型研發失敗，公司將面臨非常嚴重的財務後果。
亞歷山大王與祖克柏近日一同接受 Stripe 共同創辦人 John Collison 的 Podcast 節目《Cheeky Pint》訪問，談及 Muse Wonder 的研發歷程，以及 Meta 如何在龐大資金壓力下，推進前沿模型與個人超級智慧布局。
模型尚未驗證 祖克柏先押千億美元
亞歷山大王回憶，去年底 Meta 核心主管前往夏威夷參加年度高階主管團隊活動時，蘇珊李曾私下將他拉到一旁，嚴肅且反覆提醒：「如果這個前沿 AI 模型研發失敗了，從財務角度來看，後果將非常、非常嚴重。」
這番警告背後，是 Meta 已決定承擔的龐大基礎設施支出。當時 Muse Wonder 及整體前沿模型架構仍處於早期階段，連核心技術驗證都尚未完成，但面對 OpenAI 與 Google 加速推進 AI，祖克柏已決定擴大投入。
在拍板之前，祖克柏直接詢問亞歷山大王，是否確定這項計畫能夠成功。獲得肯定答覆後，他便決定投入 1000 億至 2000 億美元，用於 GPU、資料中心、冷卻設備及電力等基礎設施。
這也意味著，Meta 必須在模型能力尚未獲得充分驗證時，先承擔大規模投資的風險。亞歷山大王與研發團隊接下來數月的任務，就是讓模型成果足以支撐這筆投入。
測試成績亮眼 實際表現仍受質疑
Muse Wonder 隨後交出具競爭力的測試成績。完整版 Wonder Full 在綜合智慧評測中取得 56 分，超越 Fable 5.1，僅次於 Opus 5.5；在長時間軟體工程任務方面，DeepSWE 測試通過率約達 79%。
這些成績也讓 Meta 從開源 Llama 的布局，進一步跨入頂級閉源 AI 智慧體（Agent）的競爭，尤其將焦點放在需要持續執行的軟體工程任務。
不過，亮眼的測試數據並未平息外界對實際使用體驗的疑慮。Muse Wonder 發布後，部分使用者批評，模型可能過度針對基準測試最佳化，實際表現卻未必與分數相符。
例如，在生成熔岩燈的測試中，模型未能呈現燈具、玻璃與熔岩效果，反而做出紅色圓柱體。網路使用者 Token Gremlin 也批評，Muse Wonder 撰寫 Three.js 程式的表現不佳，連製作簡單的《Minecraft》仿作都令人失望。
這些回饋使 Muse Wonder 的競爭力出現兩種評價：一方面，長時間編碼任務的測試成績受到關注；另一方面，視覺化程式與展示效果仍面臨質疑。
亞歷山大王回應爭議 強調真實任務用途
面對批評，亞歷山大王在 X 發文表示，團隊開發 Muse Wonder 的目標，是打造能在真實世界中，協助真實使用者完成實際任務的模型。
他指出，研發重點放在社群平台上看起來未必亮眼的能力，而非花俏的 3D 遊戲展示。這番回應凸顯 Meta 對模型用途的定位，但實際使用體驗與測試成績之間的落差，仍是外界討論焦點。
除了能力表現，定價與版本差異也引發開發者質疑。目前開放 API 呼叫的 Muse Wonder 版本，評測得分為 52 分，低於完整版 Wonder Full 的 56 分。
然而，有開發者指出，API 版本每百萬 token 的輸入與輸出價格分別為 4 美元及 20 美元，與評測得分 58 分的 Opus 5.5 相同。完整版 Wonder Full 則僅向訂閱用戶開放，使不同版本的能力與價格差異成為另一項爭議。
長期記憶與任務應變成重點
在訪談中，祖克柏與亞歷山大王也介紹 Muse Wonder 的兩項核心功能：Active Memory 與 Active Focus，分別著重長期記憶及任務執行時的應變能力。
Active Memory 旨在讓模型記住跨越數天、數週，甚至數月的重要資訊。Meta 表示，團隊投入大量心力，讓模型能保留對使用者重要的事情，使互動不再侷限於單次對話。
當模型參與電子郵件、行程安排與個人文件等工作時，這項能力有助於延續使用者的偏好與需求，也成為部分開發者認為比單一評測分數更值得關注的方向。
Active Focus 則著重模型遇到困難時，能否持續推進任務。團隊透過大量真實世界的失敗情境進行訓練，讓模型在執行受阻時主動尋找替代方案，並在進行關鍵操作前，停下來向使用者確認。
在展示中，Muse Wonder 能持續搜尋租屋資訊，依照個人條件篩選，甚至自主聯絡房東，呈現 Meta 希望發展的個人助理用途。
祖克柏看好個人超級智慧
至於為何願意投入如此龐大的資金，祖克柏在訪談中表示，他不認為 AI 市場最終會走向贏家通吃，也不相信所有需求都將由單一大模型壟斷。
相較之下，他看好由眾多個人超級智慧組成的未來。這項判斷也呼應 Meta 成立超級智慧實驗室，以及推動智慧體商業、發展超越智慧型手機硬體的方向。
在這項構想下，具備長期記憶能力的模型可與智慧眼鏡等裝置結合，使用者的個人智慧體則能與商家的智慧體溝通、出價及購買商品，將 AI 從對話工具延伸至日常生活與商業活動。
Muse Wonder 的測試成績，為 Meta 的頂尖模型布局提供了初步成果，但實際體驗、版本差異與定價仍有待使用者檢驗。對已承擔千億美元投資的 Meta 而言，如何讓模型在真實任務中持續展現價值，正是這場 AI 豪賭的核心考驗。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) AI leader Alexandr Wang recently disclosed that before the top AI model had completed technical validation, CEO Mark Zuckerberg approved an investment of $100 billion to $200 billion to build infrastructure. This gamble prompted CFO Susan Li to solemnly warn that if the model development fails, the company could face extremely serious financial consequences.

Alexandr Wang and Mark Zuckerberg recently appeared together on Stripe co‑founder John Collison’s podcast “Cheeky Pint,” discussing the development of Muse Wonder and how Meta is pushing frontier models and personal super‑intelligence initiatives under massive funding pressure.
Zuckerberg bets billions before the model is validated

Wang recalled that at the end of last year, when Meta’s senior executives were in Hawaii for the annual senior‑leadership retreat, Susan Li pulled him aside privately and repeatedly warned, “If this frontier AI model development fails, the financial fallout will be very, very severe.”

Behind that warning is the massive infrastructure spend Meta has already committed to. At the time, Muse Wonder and the broader frontier‑model architecture were still in early stages, with core technology validation not yet completed, but faced with OpenAI and Google accelerating their AI efforts, Zuckerberg decided to increase spending.

Before signing off, Zuckerberg directly asked Wang whether he was confident the project could succeed. After receiving a positive answer, he decided to invest $100 billion to $200 billion for GPUs, data centers, cooling equipment and power infrastructure.

This means Meta must shoulder the risk of a large‑scale investment before the model’s capabilities are fully validated. Wang and his R&D team’s task over the next few months is to deliver model results that justify that outlay.
Impressive test scores but real‑world performance still questioned

Muse Wonder subsequently delivered competitive test results. The full‑version Wonder Full scored 56 in a comprehensive intelligence benchmark, beating Fable 5.1 and trailing only Opus 5.5; in long‑duration software‑engineering tasks, the DeepSWE pass rate was about 79%.
These results also moved Meta from its open‑source Llama strategy into the top tier of closed‑source AI agents, especially focusing on software‑engineering tasks that require sustained execution.

However, the strong test numbers have not quelled external doubts about actual user experience. After Muse Wonder’s release, some users criticized that the model may be over‑optimized for benchmark tests, with real‑world performance not necessarily matching the scores.

For example, in a lava‑lamp generation test the model failed to render the lamp, glass and lava effect, instead producing a red cylinder. Online user Token Gremlin also complained that Muse Wonder’s Three.js code generation was poor, even struggling to produce a simple Minecraft‑style clone.

These feedbacks created two contrasting assessments of Muse Wonder’s competitiveness: on one hand, the long‑duration coding task scores draw attention; on the other, its visual‑programming and rendering capabilities remain in doubt.
Wang responds to controversy, emphasizing real‑world task utility
Facing criticism, Wang posted on X that the team’s goal in developing Muse Wonder is to build a model that helps real users complete real tasks in the real world.

He noted that the R&D focus is on capabilities that may not look flashy on a social platform, rather than showy 3D‑game demos. This response highlights Meta’s positioning of the model’s use case, but the gap between test scores and actual experience remains a focal point of discussion.
Beyond performance, pricing and version differences have also sparked developer concerns. The currently open API version of Muse Wonder scores 52, lower than the full‑version Wonder Full’s 56.

Yet some developers point out that the API version costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, the same pricing as Opus 5.5, which scored 58. The full‑version Wonder Full is only available to subscribers, making capability and price gaps another point of contention.
Long‑term memory and task adaptability become focal points
In the interview, Zuckerberg and Wang also introduced two core features of Muse Wonder: Active Memory and Active Focus, which focus respectively on long‑term memory and adaptive task execution.

Active Memory is designed to let the model retain important information across days, weeks, or even months. Meta says the team has poured effort into enabling the model to remember user‑important details so interactions are no longer limited to a single conversation.
When the model handles email, scheduling or personal documents, this ability helps maintain user preferences and needs, and some developers view it as more noteworthy than a single benchmark score.

Active Focus concentrates on whether the model can keep pushing a task forward when it encounters difficulty. The team trained the model on many real‑world failure scenarios so that when execution stalls it proactively seeks alternatives and pauses to confirm with the user before critical actions.

In demos, Muse Wonder continuously searches rental listings, filters them according to personal criteria, and even contacts landlords autonomously, showcasing Meta’s vision for a personal‑assistant use case.
Zuckerberg bullish on personal super‑intelligence

When asked why he is willing to commit such massive funding, Zuckerberg said he does not believe the AI market will end up with a single winner monopolizing everything, nor that all demand will be satisfied by one giant model.

Instead, he is optimistic about a future composed of many personal super‑intelligences. This view aligns with Meta’s creation of a Super‑Intelligence Lab and its push toward commercial agents and hardware that goes beyond smartphones.

Under this vision, models with long‑term memory can pair with smart‑glasses and other devices, allowing a user’s personal AI to communicate, negotiate and purchase from merchant AIs, extending AI from a conversational tool to everyday life and commerce.

Muse Wonder’s test results give Meta an early foothold in its top‑model strategy, but real‑world experience, version differences and pricing still need user validation. For Meta, which has already committed a $100 billion‑plus investment, proving the model can continuously deliver value in real tasks is the core test of this AI gamble.

paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國克利夫蘭聯邦儲備銀行總裁哈瑪克主張再升息，而且中東地區襲擊事件升級，激發避險需求，週二支撐美元指於十八個月高點，但預計美國不會在中期選舉前攻擊伊朗，避免中東局勢和烏克蘭衝突升級損害共和黨選情，油價料一周來首次下跌壓抑美元，並據日本央行(BOJ)公布日本9月企業物價指數(CGPI)較前月跌0.3%及較上年同期漲6.8%不及預期，但以日圓計價進口價格指數較去年同期增24.5%，突顯日圓貶值推高原料進口成本及通貨膨脹，保持BOJ近期再加息的臆測，同時BOJ季度調查顯示，9月日本家庭預期一年後物價上漲比例降至88.6%，但預期五年後物價上漲比例升至86.5%，而且國際貨幣基金組織(IMF)預計BOJ朝著中性水平逐步升息，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓自158.66高點下跌。

◆EUR/USD
昨日據澳洲國民銀行(NAB)調查，澳洲9月企業現況指數維持負1，但企業信心指數跌至負13，遠低於伊朗衝突爆發前的2月水平，但9月澳洲央行(RBA)會議紀錄顯示，在國內需求過剩和全球能源成本上升背景下，通貨膨脹可能比此前預期更頑固，為必要時進行今年第五次升息留出空間，其鷹派基調支撐澳幣，扶助歐元兌美元穩守1.1152低點。

Cleveland Fed President Hamak argues for another rate hike, and escalating attacks in the Middle East have spurred safe‑haven demand, supporting the dollar at an 18‑month high on Tuesday. However, the US is not expected to strike Iran before the mid‑term elections to avoid worsening the Middle East situation and the Ukraine conflict, which could hurt Republican prospects. Oil prices are projected to fall for the first time in a week, pressuring the dollar. Japan’s BOJ reported that September’s corporate goods price index (CGPI) fell 0.3% month‑on‑month and rose 6.8% year‑on‑year, missing expectations, while the import price index measured in yen was up 24.5% YoY, highlighting that yen depreciation is raising raw‑material import costs and inflation, keeping speculation of another BOJ rate hike alive. A BOJ quarterly survey showed Japanese households expect price growth one year ahead to drop to 88.6% but five‑year‑ahead expectations to rise to 86.5%. The IMF expects the BOJ to gradually raise rates toward a neutral stance, which could boost the yen, and the dollar‑yen pair has slipped from the 158.66 peak.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said core inflation is already very close to the 2% target and stabilising around that level is crucial. A sharp fall in Asian equities has sparked yen safe‑haven demand, pushing USD/JPY down to a 157.81 low. Meanwhile, the National Association of Realtors reported US existing‑home sales rose 1.5% in September to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 3.99 million. New York Fed President Williams believes no further rate hikes are needed next year, but Fed Governor Waller said recent US Treasury yield rises reflect faster economic growth and solid inflation expectations. Chicago Fed President Goolsbee warned that the AI investment boom’s spill‑over effects could fuel inflation, supporting a dollar rebound. Today’s focus is US inflation data, with dollar‑yen resistance around 158.70‑90 and support around 157.70‑90.

items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Slides from 18-Month High as Oil Prices Fall, Inflation Data in Focus
paras: 美元周二(13日)自18個月高點滑落，隨著油價下跌，加上市場重新評估今年支撐美國資產需求、由人工智慧(AI)題材帶動的漲勢。投資人同時等待更多有關聯準會(Fed)利率政策走向的線索。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.37%，報102.18。該指數週一曾升至102.61，創2025年4月以來最高。
Corpay首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta表示，「隨著市場對AI相關股票估值的合理性及漲勢能否持續產生更多疑慮，美元正走弱。這可能抑制流入美國金融市場的資金。」
紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)表示，他仍預期今年會再升息一次，但認為2027年沒有必要進一步升息。此番言論公布後，美元跌幅進一步擴大。
市場預期，美國總統川普將避免中東局勢進一步升級，因為更大規模的衝突可能損害他在下個月期中選舉前的政治支持度。
川普上週表示，美國不會在選舉前攻擊伊朗，他也在週日提及俄羅斯與烏克蘭之間的能源停火安排。
週二油價下跌0.75%，至每桶105.87 美元，交易人士正評估俄羅斯是否可能額外增加柴油供應。俄羅斯表示，其柴油出口量可恢復至高於川普在與莫斯科達成的協議中所提及水準。
分析師指出，除了能源因素之外，市場對AI帶動投資的前景日益存疑，也正在挑戰近期美元漲勢。
投資人正等待週三公布的美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)，這項數據將進一步提供聯準會未來是否收緊貨幣政策的線索。
在兩名聯準會官員主張應蒐集更多證據，再決定是否有必要進一步緊縮政策後，投資人已放棄對本月稍晚升息的押注。
芝商所(CME Group)FedWatch工具顯示，交易員預期聯準會在10月27至28日會議上維持利率不變的機率約為80%，高於一個月前的51%。另一方面，市場目前預期截至2027年底，聯準會累計緊縮幅度約為75個基點。
渣打銀行全球G10外匯研究主管暨北美宏觀策略主管Steven Englander表示，「我們認為通膨數據可能會略低於預期。油價仍帶來一些數據公布前的風險，但推升核心通膨的部分因素正在消退。關稅已經是去年的話題了。」
近期油價上漲曾支撐美元，並使歐元、日元等貨幣承壓，因歐元區與日本的經濟對進口石油的依賴程度遠高於美國。
歐元反彈 儘管天然氣價格升高
儘管天然氣價格再度大漲，而天然氣是推升歐元區通膨的重要因素之一，加上法國財政前景仍令人擔憂，歐元仍從約17個月低點反彈。
歐元兌美元上漲0.40%，至1歐元兌1.1198 美元。週一歐元曾跌至1.11525美元，為2025年5月以來最低。
Englander表示，「歐洲各國公債殖利率利差略有收斂。就市場對法國財政脆弱性的看法而言，我們還沒有到達最高警戒狀態，相關擔憂已經有所緩和。」
歐洲天然氣價格升至2022年12月以來最高水準，最新報價為每百萬瓦時86.74歐元。
日本銀行(BoJ)公布數據顯示，日本9月批發物價年增率為6.8%，低於市場預估中位數的7.6%。儘管如此，數據仍足以支撐市場對日本利率可能進一步上升的擔憂。日元兌美元升值0.18%，至158.33日元兌1美元。
投資人仍認為，日銀進一步收緊貨幣政策的可能性，以及官方可能出手干預過度的匯率波動，將為日元提供支撐。
澳幣兌美元報0.69830美元。此前，澳洲央行(RBA)公布9月會議紀錄，顯示委員會一致同意今年第四度升息。
